missions.phrase: Маша поёт и танцует на сцене.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: и (coord. conj., 'and'; also additive particle 'even/also'). Per-token: Маша (f. proper noun, nom.sg., subject) | поёт (3sg pres impf of петь, 'to sing') | и (coord. conj. linking two verbs) | танцует (3sg pres impf of танцевать, 'to dance') | на (prep., + prep. for location) | сцене (f. noun, prep.sg. of сцена). И coordinates two finite verbs sharing the same subject; no comma is needed before a single и joining two predicates.
missions.literal: Masha sings and dances on the stage.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: в (prep.; + prep. = static location 'in', + acc. = direction 'into'). Per-token: Мой (poss. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with брат) | брат (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | живёт (3sg pres impf of жить, 'to live') | в (prep., + prep. for static location) | Петербурге (m. proper noun, prep.sg. of Петербург). With verbs of being/living, в takes the prepositional case to denote where someone is located.
missions.literal: My brother lives in Petersburg.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: не (neg. particle, negates the following word). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | не (neg. particle directly before verb) | понимаю (1sg pres impf of понимать, 'to understand') | твоего (poss. pron., m.gen.sg., agrees with вопроса) | вопроса (m. noun, gen.sg. of вопрос). Direct objects of negated transitive verbs often shift from accusative to genitive — the so-called 'genitive of negation'.
missions.literal: I don't understand your question.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: он (3sg.m pers. pron., nom.; oblique stem ег-/нем-). Per-token: Он (3sg.m pers. pron., nom., subject) | работает (3sg pres impf of работать, 'to work') | врачом (m. noun, instr.sg. of врач, 'doctor') | в (prep., + prep. for location) | больнице (f. noun, prep.sg. of больница). 'Работать кем' takes the instrumental for profession/role — a classic predicate-instrumental pattern.
missions.literal: He works as a doctor at the hospital.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: на (prep.; + acc. = direction onto, + prep. = location on). Per-token: Поставь (2sg imp of поставить perf., 'to put/place upright') | чашку (f. noun, acc.sg. of чашка, direct object) | на (prep., + acc. for direction) | стол (m. inan. noun, acc.sg., same form as nom.) | пожалуйста (politeness particle, 'please'). With verbs of placement and motion, на governs the accusative because the chashka is moving onto the surface.
missions.literal: Put the cup on the table, please.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: я (1sg pers. pron., nom.; obl. stem мен-/мн-). Per-token: Завтра (adv., 'tomorrow') | я (1sg pers. pron., nom., subject) | уезжаю (1sg pres impf of уезжать, 'to leave/depart by transport') | в (prep., + acc. for direction) | командировку (f. noun, acc.sg. of командировка, 'business trip'). Russian uses the present imperfective with future-time adverbs to express scheduled near-future events.
missions.literal: Tomorrow I'm leaving on a business trip.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: что (interrog./rel. pron., 'what'; nom./acc. same form). Per-token: Что (interrog. pron., nom.sg., subject) | случилось (n.sg. past of случиться perf., 'to happen', refl.) | с (prep., + instr. for accompaniment/'with') | твоей (poss. pron., f.instr.sg., agrees with машиной) | машиной (f. noun, instr.sg. of машина). The verb agrees with neuter что in the singular; случиться is reflexive and inherently perfective.
missions.literal: What happened to your car?

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: тот (dem. pron., 'that one'; declines like adjective). Per-token: Тот (dem. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with фильм) | фильм (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | мне (1sg pers. pron., dat.) | очень (adv. of degree, 'very') | понравился (m.sg. past of понравиться perf., refl., 'to please'). With нравиться/понравиться, the experiencer goes in the dative and the thing liked is the grammatical subject.
missions.literal: I really liked that film.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: быть (inf. of impf. copula 'to be'; pres. omitted, past был/была/было/были, fut. буду). Per-token: Хочу (1sg pres impf of хотеть, 'to want') | быть (inf. of быть) | честным (adj., m.instr.sg., predicate complement of быть) | с (prep., + instr.) | тобой (2sg pers. pron., instr.). After infinitive быть the nominal/adjectival complement takes the instrumental — a core pattern for predicate nouns.
missions.literal: I want to be honest with you.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: с (prep.; + instr. = 'with', + gen. = 'from/off'). Per-token: Мы (1pl pers. pron., nom., subject) | ужинали (pl. past impf of ужинать, 'to have dinner') | с (prep., + instr. for accompaniment) | родителями (m. pl. noun, instr.pl. of родители, 'parents') | вчера (adv. of time, 'yesterday'). Comitative с always requires the instrumental case; the past tense agrees with the plural subject.
missions.literal: We had dinner with my parents yesterday.

missions.phrase: Я люблю чай, а он кофе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: а (coord. conj. of mild contrast, 'whereas/and'). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | люблю (1sg pres impf of любить, 'to love/like') | чай (m. inan. noun, acc.sg., same as nom., direct object) | а (coord. conj. of contrast) | он (3sg.m pers. pron., nom.) | кофе (m. indecl. noun, acc.sg., direct object, verb elided). А marks contrast between two parallel clauses; the second clause omits the verb that's recoverable from the first.
missions.literal: I like tea, and he likes coffee.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: весь (det. pron., 'all/whole'; irregular declension). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | съел (m.sg. past of съесть perf., 'to eat up') | весь (det. pron., m.acc.sg. = nom. for inanimate, agrees with торт) | торт (m. inan. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | сам (intens. pron., m.nom.sg., 'by myself'). Perfective съел emphasises totality of the action; весь agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies.
missions.literal: I ate the whole cake by myself.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: это (dem./presentational pron., n.sg.; invariable when used as 'this is'). Per-token: Это (presentational pron., subject) | была (f.sg. past of быть, 'to be') | настоящая (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with катастрофа) | катастрофа (f. noun, nom.sg., predicate nominative). When это introduces a predicate noun in the past, the copula was/была agrees in gender with the predicate noun, not with neuter это.
missions.literal: That was a real disaster.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: как (interrog./rel. adv., 'how/as'). Per-token: Как (interrog. adv., 'how') | тебя (2sg pers. pron., acc.) | зовут (3pl pres impf of звать, 'to call', impersonal use) | малыш (m. noun, voc./nom.sg., direct address). The standard 'what's your name?' uses impersonal 3pl зовут + accusative object — literally 'how do they call you'.
missions.literal: What's your name, little one?

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: она (3sg.f pers. pron., nom.; obl. её/ней). Per-token: Она (3sg.f pers. pron., nom., subject) | преподаёт (3sg pres impf of преподавать, 'to teach') | русский (adj., m.acc.sg., agrees with язык) | язык (m. inan. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | иностранцам (m. pl. noun, dat.pl. of иностранец, indirect object). Преподавать takes the accusative of the subject taught and dative of the learners.
missions.literal: She teaches Russian to foreigners.

missions.phrase: Дети бегают по двору с собакой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: по (prep.; + dat. = 'along/around/according to', + acc. = 'up to', + prep. = 'after'). Per-token: Дети (pl. noun, nom.pl., subject) | бегают (3pl pres impf of бегать, 'to run around' indeterminate) | по (prep., + dat. for surface/area traversed) | двору (m. noun, dat.sg. of двор) | с (prep., + instr.) | собакой (f. noun, instr.sg. of собака). With multidirectional verbs of motion, по + dative expresses scattered movement over an area.
missions.literal: The kids are running around the yard with the dog.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: но (coord. conj. of strong adversative contrast, 'but'). Per-token: Хотел (m.sg. past impf of хотеть) | позвонить (inf. of perf. позвонить, 'to call') | но (coord. conj. of contrast) | забыл (m.sg. past of забыть perf., 'to forget') | телефон (m. inan. noun, acc.sg., direct object). Но introduces an unexpected obstacle; perfective забыл marks the single completed event of forgetting.
missions.literal: I wanted to call, but I forgot my phone.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: они (3pl pers. pron., nom.; obl. их/них). Per-token: Они (3pl pers. pron., nom., subject) | переехали (pl. past of переехать perf., 'to move residence') | в (prep., + acc. for direction) | новую (adj., f.acc.sg., agrees with квартиру) | квартиру (f. noun, acc.sg. of квартира). Перфective переехать with в + accusative marks the completed change of residence.
missions.literal: They moved into a new apartment.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: к (prep.; + dat. = 'towards/to' a person or point). Per-token: Подойди (2sg imp of подойти perf., 'to approach') | к (prep., + dat. for direction towards) | окну (n. noun, dat.sg. of окно) | и (coord. conj.) | посмотри (2sg imp of посмотреть perf., 'to take a look'). К is the standard preposition for motion towards an object or person and always governs the dative.
missions.literal: Come over to the window and have a look.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: у (prep.; + gen. = possession 'at/by', 'have' construction). Per-token: У (prep., + gen. for possession) | моего (poss. pron., m.gen.sg., agrees with соседа) | соседа (m. anim. noun, gen.sg. of сосед) | большая (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with собака) | собака (f. noun, nom.sg., grammatical subject). The 'have' construction puts the possessor in у + genitive and the possessed item in the nominative; есть is omitted when describing what kind.
missions.literal: My neighbour has a big dog.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: ты (2sg informal pers. pron., nom.; obl. тебя/тебе). Per-token: Где (interrog. adv., 'where') | ты (2sg pers. pron., nom., subject) | был (m.sg. past of быть) | всё (det. pron., n.acc.sg., agrees with утро) | утро (n. noun, acc.sg., acc. of duration). The accusative of time expresses duration without a preposition: 'all morning long'.
missions.literal: Where were you all morning?

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: из (prep.; + gen. = 'out of/from' the interior of). Per-token: Бабушка (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | приехала (f.sg. past of приехать perf., 'to arrive by transport') | из (prep., + gen. for origin) | деревни (f. noun, gen.sg. of деревня) | вчера (adv. of time). Из pairs with в — if you go в деревню, you return из деревни.
missions.literal: Grandma arrived from the village yesterday.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: мы (1pl pers. pron., nom.; obl. нас/нам). Per-token: Завтра (adv. of time) | мы (1pl pers. pron., nom., subject) | пойдём (1pl fut. of пойти perf., 'to set off on foot') | в (prep., + acc. for direction) | кино (n. indecl. noun, acc.sg., 'cinema'). Perfective пойти forms a simple future without an auxiliary; кино is indeclinable.
missions.literal: Tomorrow we're going to the cinema.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: за (prep.; + acc. = 'for/behind' direction, + instr. = static 'behind/after'). Per-token: Спасибо (n. noun used as interj., 'thanks') | за (prep., + acc. for cause/reason of gratitude) | помощь (f. noun, acc.sg., same as nom., direct object of preposition) | и (coord. conj.) | поддержку (f. noun, acc.sg. of поддержка). Спасибо за + accusative is the fixed pattern for naming what you're thanking someone for.
missions.literal: Thanks for your help and support.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: вы (2pl/2sg formal pers. pron., nom.). Per-token: Где (interrog. adv.) | вы (2pl pers. pron., nom., subject, here polite singular) | работаете (2pl pres impf of работать, plural-form ending obligatory with formal вы) | Иван (m. proper noun, nom.sg.) | Петрович (m. patronymic, nom.sg.). The polite вы always triggers plural verb agreement, even when addressing one person; first-name + patronymic is the standard respectful form of address.
missions.literal: Where do you work, Ivan Petrovich?

missions.phrase: Не говори со мной так грубо.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: так (adv. of manner/degree, 'so/in that way'). Per-token: Не (neg. particle) | говори (2sg imp of говорить, 'to speak') | со (variant of с before consonant clusters, + instr.) | мной (1sg pers. pron., instr.) | так (adv. of manner) | грубо (adv. of manner, 'rudely'). Imperfective imperative with не expresses a general prohibition; так intensifies the following adverb.
missions.literal: Don't talk to me so rudely.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: же (emphatic/contrastive particle, second-position, untranslatable filler). Per-token: Где (interrog. adv.) | же (emphatic particle, attaches to preceding stressed word) | мои (poss. pron., m.pl.nom., agrees with ключи) | ключи (m. pl. noun, nom.pl. of ключ, subject) | лежат (3pl pres impf of лежать, 'to lie'). Же in questions expresses puzzlement or impatience and always follows the focused word.
missions.literal: Where on earth are my keys?

missions.phrase: Я устал от его постоянных жалоб.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: от (prep.; + gen. = 'from/away from', source/cause). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | устал (m.sg. past of устать perf., 'to grow tired') | от (prep., + gen. of cause) | его (poss. pron., indecl., 'his') | постоянных (adj., gen.pl., agrees with жалоб) | жалоб (f. noun, gen.pl. of жалоба). Уставать/устать от + genitive names the cause of the fatigue.
missions.literal: I'm tired of his constant complaints.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: сказать (perf. inf., 'to say'; impf. counterpart говорить). Per-token: Мне (1sg pers. pron., dat., experiencer) | нужно (impersonal pred., 'need to') | сказать (perf. inf.) | вам (2pl pers. pron., dat., indirect object) | правду (f. noun, acc.sg. of правда, direct object). Нужно + infinitive uses the dative for the person who needs; perfective сказать stresses the single act of telling.
missions.literal: I need to tell you the truth.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: этот (dem. pron., 'this'; declines like adjective with stem эт-). Per-token: Этот (dem. pron., m.acc.sg.=nom. for inanimate, agrees with рецепт) | рецепт (m. inan. noun, acc.sg., direct object fronted for emphasis) | мне (1sg pers. pron., dat., indirect object) | передала (f.sg. past of передать perf., 'to hand down/pass on') | бабушка (f. noun, nom.sg., subject). Russian freely fronts the object before the subject for topicalisation; этот agrees with рецепт despite the word-order shuffle.
missions.literal: Grandma passed this recipe down to me.

missions.phrase: Это книга, которую я давно ищу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: который (rel. pron., 'which/who'; declines as adjective, takes case from its role in the relative clause). Per-token: Это (presentational pron.) | книга (f. noun, nom.sg., predicate nominative) | которую (rel. pron., f.acc.sg., direct object inside relative clause) | я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | давно (adv. of time, 'for a long time') | ищу (1sg pres impf of искать, 'to search for'). Который agrees in gender and number with its antecedent (книга → f.sg.) but takes the case dictated by its function in the embedded clause (here acc. as object of ищу).
missions.literal: This is the book I've been looking for for ages.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: мочь (impf. inf., 'to be able'; irregular present: могу, можешь, может). Per-token: Извини (2sg imp of извинить perf., 'to forgive/excuse') | я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | не (neg. particle) | могу (1sg pres impf of мочь) | прийти (perf. inf., 'to come/arrive'). Мочь takes a bare infinitive complement and is the standard modal for ability/possibility; the negated form excuses oneself from an obligation.
missions.literal: Sorry, I can't come.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: человек (m. anim. noun, 'person/man'; suppletive pl. люди). Per-token: Этот (dem. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with человек) | человек (m. anim. noun, nom.sg., subject) | спас (m.sg. past of спасти perf., 'to save') | мне (1sg pers. pron., dat., indirect object) | жизнь (f. noun, acc.sg., direct object). Спасти жизнь + dative of person is a fixed construction for 'to save someone's life'.
missions.literal: This man saved my life.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: о (prep.; + prep. = 'about/concerning'; об before vowels). Per-token: Расскажи (2sg imp of рассказать perf., 'to tell/recount') | мне (1sg pers. pron., dat., indirect object) | о (prep., + prep. for topic) | своей (refl. poss. pron., f.prep.sg., agrees with поездке) | поездке (f. noun, prep.sg. of поездка). Рассказывать/рассказать о + prepositional names the topic of the narration; свой is used because the trip belongs to the addressee = subject of the imperative.
missions.literal: Tell me about your trip.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: один (numeral/det., 'one/a certain'; declines like этот). Per-token: Остался (m.sg. past of остаться perf., 'to remain', refl.) | один (numeral, m.nom.sg., agrees with кусок) | кусок (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | пирога (m. noun, gen.sg. of пирог, partitive). Один agrees fully with its noun in gender, number and case; the genitive пирога expresses the whole from which the piece comes.
missions.literal: One piece of pie is left.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: еще (adv., 'more/still/another'; also spelled ещё). Per-token: Налей (2sg imp of налить perf., 'to pour') | мне (1sg pers. pron., dat., indirect object) | еще (adv. of quantity, 'another') | чашку (f. noun, acc.sg. of чашка, direct object) | чая (m. noun, gen.sg. of чай, partitive genitive). With еще + a measure noun, the substance is in the partitive genitive: 'another cup of tea'.
missions.literal: Pour me another cup of tea.

missions.phrase: На твоём месте я бы согласился.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: бы (subjunctive/conditional particle, attaches to past-tense verb). Per-token: На (prep., + prep. for location) | твоём (poss. pron., n.prep.sg., agrees with месте) | месте (n. noun, prep.sg. of место) | я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | бы (subjunctive particle) | согласился (m.sg. past of согласиться perf., refl., 'to agree'). Past-tense form + бы produces the irrealis 'would' meaning; 'на твоём месте' is the idiomatic 'if I were you'.
missions.literal: If I were you, I would agree.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: такой (det. pron., 'such (a)'; declines as adjective). Per-token: Сегодня (adv. of time, 'today') | такой (det. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with ветер) | холодный (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with ветер) | ветер (m. noun, nom.sg., subject of zero copula). Такой intensifies a following long-form adjective in exclamations, where какой would head a wh-exclamation.
missions.literal: What a cold wind today!

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: только (adv./particle, 'only/just'). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | выпью (1sg fut. of выпить perf., 'to drink up') | только (restrictive particle, 'only') | один (numeral, m.acc.sg.=nom. for inanimate, agrees with стакан) | стакан (m. inan. noun, acc.sg., direct object). Только typically precedes the constituent it restricts; perfective выпью marks the bounded act of finishing a drink.
missions.literal: I'll drink only one glass.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: себя (refl. pron., 'oneself'; no nom., declines for case only). Per-token: Чувствую (1sg pres impf of чувствовать, 'to feel') | себя (refl. pron., acc., direct object coreferential with subject) | совершенно (adv. of degree, 'completely') | разбитым (past pass. ptcp. of разбить, m.instr.sg., predicate complement). Чувствовать себя + instrumental of adjective/participle is the idiomatic 'to feel (in some state)'.
missions.literal: I feel completely wrecked.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: свое (refl. poss. pron., n.nom./acc.sg.; refers back to the subject; also spelled своё). Per-token: Каждый (det. pron., m.nom.sg., subject, 'everyone') | защищает (3sg pres impf of защищать, 'to defend') | своё (refl. poss. pron., n.acc.sg., agrees with мнение) | мнение (n. noun, acc.sg., direct object). Свой/своё is obligatory when the possessor is the subject of the clause — using его here would imply someone else's opinion.
missions.literal: Everyone defends their own opinion.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: какой (interrog./excl. pron., 'which/what kind of'; declines as adjective). Per-token: Какой (interrog. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with цвет) | у (prep., + gen. for possession) | тебя (2sg pers. pron., gen.) | любимый (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with цвет) | цвет (m. noun, nom.sg., subject). Possession 'have' uses у + gen. + nominative; какой quizzes about a quality of the noun it modifies.
missions.literal: What's your favourite colour?

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: когда (interrog./rel. adv./conj., 'when'). Per-token: Позвони (2sg imp of позвонить perf., 'to call') | мне (1sg pers. pron., dat., indirect object) | когда (temporal conj.) | будешь (2sg fut. of быть, 'to be') | свободен (short-form adj., m.sg., predicate, 'free/available'). Future-time когда-clauses in Russian use the future tense (not present, unlike English); short-form adjectives often serve as temporary-state predicates.
missions.literal: Call me when you're free.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: уже (adv., 'already'). Per-token: Поезд (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | уже (adv. of time) | отошёл (m.sg. past of отойти perf., 'to move away/depart') | от (prep., + gen. for source) | платформы (f. noun, gen.sg. of платформа). Уже + perfective past stresses that the action is now completed contrary to expectation; отойти 'depart' pairs with от + genitive.
missions.literal: The train has already left the platform.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: для (prep.; + gen. = 'for/intended for'). Per-token: Это (presentational pron.) | упражнение (n. noun, nom.sg., predicate nominative) | для (prep., + gen. of beneficiary/purpose) | начинающих (pres. act. ptcp. of начинать used as adj., gen.pl., agrees with учеников) | учеников (m. anim. noun, gen.pl. of ученик). Для names the intended recipient or purpose and always governs the genitive.
missions.literal: This exercise is for beginner students.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: вот (presentational particle, 'here is/are' — pointing). Per-token: Вот (presentational particle) | документы (m. pl. noun, nom.pl. of документ, subject) | которые (rel. pron., m.pl.acc., agrees with antecedent, object inside rel. clause) | ты (2sg pers. pron., nom.) | просил (m.sg. past impf of просить, 'to ask for'). Вот presents something to the listener's attention; который takes its case (acc.) from its role inside the relative clause.
missions.literal: Here are the documents you asked for.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: кто (interrog./rel. pron., 'who'; takes m.sg. agreement on verbs). Per-token: Кто (interrog. pron., nom.sg., subject) | из (prep., + gen. of partitive source) | вас (2pl pers. pron., gen.) | умеет (3sg pres impf of уметь, 'to know how') | плавать (impf. inf., 'to swim'). Кто triggers default m.sg. verb agreement even when the answer is plural or female; из + gen. picks out a subset.
missions.literal: Which of you knows how to swim?

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: да (particle; here 'long live/may'; elsewhere 'yes'). Per-token: Да (optative particle, 'let/may') | здравствует (3sg pres impf of здравствовать, 'to thrive/be well') | наша (poss. pron., f.nom.sg., agrees with свобода) | свобода (f. noun, nom.sg., subject). Да + 3rd-person present forms a fossilised optative ('may X live/be'), common in slogans and toasts.
missions.literal: Long live our freedom!

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: говорить (impf. inf., 'to speak/say'; perf. сказать for single utterance). Per-token: Перестань (2sg imp of перестать perf., 'to stop/cease') | говорить (impf. inf.) | громко (adv. of manner, 'loudly') | в (prep., + prep. for location) | библиотеке (f. noun, prep.sg. of библиотека). Перестать always takes the imperfective infinitive — you stop an ongoing or habitual action, never a perfective one.
missions.literal: Stop talking loudly in the library.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: год (m. noun, 'year'; gen.pl. лет, suppletive after numerals 5+). Per-token: Прошёл (m.sg. past of пройти perf., 'to pass/go by') | целый (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with год) | год (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | без (prep., + gen. of absence) | новостей (f. noun, gen.pl. of новость). Time spans use пройти + nominative for 'X passed'; без + genitive expresses lack.
missions.literal: A whole year went by without any news.

missions.phrase: Хотелось бы знать его настоящее имя.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: знать (impf. inf., 'to know (a fact)'; contrast with уметь 'know how' and узнать 'find out'). Per-token: Хотелось (n.sg. past impf of хотеться, impers., refl., 'to feel like') | бы (subjunctive particle) | знать (impf. inf.) | его (poss. pron., indecl., 'his') | настоящее (adj., n.acc.sg., agrees with имя) | имя (n. noun, acc.sg., direct object). Impersonal хотелось бы + infinitive is the polite 'I'd like to'; subject is implicit, no dative needed when general.
missions.literal: I'd like to know his real name.

missions.phrase: Мой младший брат играет на гитаре.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: мой (1sg poss. pron., 'my'; declines as soft adj.). Per-token: Мой (poss. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with брат) | младший (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with брат, 'younger') | брат (m. anim. noun, nom.sg., subject) | играет (3sg pres impf of играть, 'to play') | на (prep., + prep. for instrument played) | гитаре (f. noun, prep.sg. of гитара). Играть на + prepositional names the musical instrument; играть в + accusative names a game.
missions.literal: My younger brother plays the guitar.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: до (prep.; + gen. = 'until/up to/before'). Per-token: До (prep., + gen. for time point) | встречи (f. noun, gen.sg. of встреча) | в (prep., + acc. for day of week) | субботу (f. noun, acc.sg. of суббота) | вечером (n. noun, instr.sg. of вечер, time-when). 'До встречи' is a fixed parting; days of the week take в + accusative, while times of day take the bare instrumental.
missions.literal: See you on Saturday evening!

missions.phrase: Мы поедем на машине или поездом?
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: или (coord. conj., 'or'; can also be doubled или…или). Per-token: Мы (1pl pers. pron., nom.) | поедем (1pl fut. of поехать perf., 'to set off by transport') | на (prep., + prep. for means of transport) | машине (f. noun, prep.sg. of машина) | или (coord. conj.) | поездом (m. noun, instr.sg. of поезд, instrumental of means). Means of transport allow both на + prep. and the bare instrumental — Russian frequently mixes the two within a single sentence.
missions.literal: Shall we go by car or by train?

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: если (subord. conj., 'if'; real condition). Per-token: Если (cond. conj.) | хочешь (2sg pres impf of хотеть) | я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | могу (1sg pres impf of мочь) | помочь (perf. inf., 'to help'). Если introduces a real conditional with indicative tenses; for counterfactual 'if', Russian uses если бы + past.
missions.literal: If you want, I can help.

missions.phrase: Сейчас не лучшее время для разговора.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: время (n. noun, 'time'; irregular -мя type, gen./dat./prep.sg. времени, instr. временем). Per-token: Сейчас (adv. of time, 'now') | не (neg. particle) | лучшее (adj., n.nom.sg., superlative/comparative of хороший, agrees with время) | время (n. noun, nom.sg., predicate nominative) | для (prep., + gen.) | разговора (m. noun, gen.sg. of разговор). Время for purpose takes для + genitive; the negated predicate noun stays in the nominative here because it's part of a copular construction with zero быть.
missions.literal: Now isn't the best time for a conversation.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: рука (f. noun, 'hand/arm'; acc.sg. руку with stress shift). Per-token: Возьми (2sg imp of взять perf., 'to take') | меня (1sg pers. pron., acc.) | за (prep., + acc. for the body part grabbed) | руку (f. noun, acc.sg. of рука) | пожалуйста (politeness particle). The body-part construction 'verb someone за + body part in acc.' is the standard way to express touching/grabbing in Russian.
missions.literal: Take me by the hand, please.

missions.phrase: У нас нет времени на споры.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: нет (negative existential, 'there is no'; combines with gen.; also the answer 'no'). Per-token: У (prep., + gen. for possessor) | нас (1pl pers. pron., gen.) | нет (neg. existential) | времени (n. noun, gen.sg. of время) | на (prep., + acc. for purpose) | споры (m. pl. noun, acc.pl. of спор). Нет always governs the genitive of the thing absent; the possessor goes in у + genitive.
missions.literal: We don't have time for arguments.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: самый (intens. det., used to form analytical superlative 'the most'). Per-token: Москва (f. proper noun, nom.sg., subject) | — (em-dash standing in for zero copula) | самый (det., m.nom.sg., agrees with город) | большой (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with город) | город (m. noun, nom.sg., predicate nominative) | России (f. proper noun, gen.sg. of Россия). Самый + long-form adjective is the productive Russian superlative; em-dash replaces the missing 'is' between two nominatives.
missions.literal: Moscow is the biggest city in Russia.

missions.phrase: Я не сказал ни одного слова.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: ни (emphatic neg. particle, reinforces не; pairs with negated verbs). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | не (neg. particle) | сказал (m.sg. past of сказать perf.) | ни (emphatic neg. particle) | одного (numeral, n.gen.sg., agrees with слова) | слова (n. noun, gen.sg. of слово, genitive of negation). 'Ни одного' + genitive = 'not a single'; the double negative is grammatically obligatory in Russian, not stigmatised.
missions.literal: I didn't say a single word.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: стать (perf. inf., 'to become'; impf. становиться). Per-token: Моя (poss. pron., f.nom.sg., agrees with сестра) | сестра (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | хочет (3sg pres impf of хотеть) | стать (perf. inf.) | архитектором (m. noun, instr.sg. of архитектор, predicate instr.). The predicate complement of стать/становиться is always in the instrumental.
missions.literal: My sister wants to become an architect.

missions.phrase: Между нами большая разница в возрасте.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: большой (adj., 'big/large'; suppletive comparative больше). Per-token: Между (prep., + instr. for 'between') | нами (1pl pers. pron., instr.) | большая (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with разница) | разница (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | в (prep., + prep. for the dimension) | возрасте (m. noun, prep.sg. of возраст). Между governs the instrumental; разница в + prepositional names the dimension along which two things differ.
missions.literal: There's a big age difference between us.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: даже (focus particle, 'even'). Per-token: Даже (focus particle preceding focused constituent) | учитель (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | не (neg. particle) | знал (m.sg. past impf of знать) | ответа (m. noun, gen.sg. of ответ, genitive of negation). Даже always precedes the word it scopes over; under negation the object shifts from accusative to genitive.
missions.literal: Even the teacher didn't know the answer.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: другой (det. pron./adj., 'other/another'). Per-token: Давай (1pl hortative particle/imp of давать, 'let's') | встретимся (1pl fut. of встретиться perf., refl., 'to meet') | в (prep., + acc. for occasion) | другой (det., m.acc.sg.=nom. for inanimate, agrees with раз) | раз (m. noun, acc.sg., temporal). 'В другой раз' is a fixed expression for 'some other time'; давай + 1pl perfective future = let's-suggestion.
missions.literal: Let's meet some other time.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: наш (1pl poss. pron., 'our'; declines as soft adj.). Per-token: Наша (poss. pron., f.nom.sg., agrees with команда) | команда (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | выиграла (f.sg. past of выиграть perf., 'to win') | важный (adj., m.acc.sg.=nom. for inanimate, agrees with матч) | матч (m. inan. noun, acc.sg., direct object). Perfective выиграть emphasises the completed result; possessive наш agrees fully with its noun.
missions.literal: Our team won an important match.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: свой (refl. poss. pron., refers back to the subject; declines as soft adj.). Per-token: Положи (2sg imp of положить perf., 'to put down') | свой (refl. poss. pron., m.acc.sg.=nom. for inanimate, agrees with рюкзак) | рюкзак (m. inan. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | на (prep., + acc. for direction onto) | стул (m. inan. noun, acc.sg.). Свой refers to the addressee = implicit subject of the imperative — using твой here would be possible but less idiomatic.
missions.literal: Put your backpack on the chair.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: ну (discourse particle, 'well/come on'). Per-token: Ну (discourse particle, softens/intensifies the question) | что (interrog. adv. here, 'why/what for') | ты (2sg pers. pron., nom.) | так (adv. of degree, 'so') | расстроился (m.sg. past of расстроиться perf., refl., 'to get upset'). 'Ну что' opens a slightly reproachful question; что + adjective/adverb often means 'why' in colloquial speech.
missions.literal: Come on, why did you get so upset?

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: под (prep.; + instr. = static 'under', + acc. = motion 'underneath'). Per-token: Кот (m. anim. noun, nom.sg., subject) | спрятался (m.sg. past of спрятаться perf., refl., 'to hide') | под (prep., + instr. for location, since the cat ended up there and is now stationary) | старым (adj., m.instr.sg., agrees with диваном) | диваном (m. noun, instr.sg. of диван). After спрятаться (now in a hidden location), под takes the instrumental of place, not the accusative of direction.
missions.literal: The cat hid under the old sofa.

missions.phrase: Где ты купил такие красивые туфли?
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: где (interrog./rel. adv. of static location). Per-token: Где (interrog. adv.) | ты (2sg pers. pron., nom.) | купил (m.sg. past of купить perf., 'to buy') | такие (det. pron., f.pl.acc.=nom., agrees with туфли) | красивые (adj., f.pl.acc., agrees with туфли) | туфли (f. pl. tantum noun, acc.pl., direct object). Где asks about static location (vs. куда for direction); туфли is plural-only.
missions.literal: Where did you buy such beautiful shoes?

missions.phrase: Не суй нос в чужие дела.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: дело (n. noun, 'matter/business/affair'; pl. дела). Per-token: Не (neg. particle) | суй (2sg imp of совать impf., 'to stick/poke') | нос (m. inan. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | в (prep., + acc. for direction) | чужие (adj., m.pl.acc.=nom. for inanimate, agrees with дела) | дела (n. pl. noun, acc.pl. of дело). Imperfective imperative 'не суй' issues a generic prohibition; the saying is the Russian counterpart of 'mind your own business'.
missions.literal: Don't stick your nose into other people's business.

missions.phrase: У бабушки есть огромная коллекция марок.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: есть (3sg pres of быть, used as existential 'there is/has'). Per-token: У (prep., + gen. for possessor) | бабушки (f. noun, gen.sg. of бабушка) | есть (existential pres. of быть) | огромная (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with коллекция) | коллекция (f. noun, nom.sg., grammatical subject) | марок (f. noun, gen.pl. of марка, partitive). Есть is kept when asserting existence/ownership of the thing itself; it's dropped when describing a quality of an already-known item.
missions.literal: Grandma has a huge stamp collection.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: сам (intens. pron., 'oneself/in person'; declines, contrast with refl. себя). Per-token: Президент (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | сам (intens. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with президент) | подписал (m.sg. past of подписать perf., 'to sign') | это (dem. pron., n.acc.sg., agrees with соглашение) | соглашение (n. noun, acc.sg., direct object). Сам emphasises that the subject — and no one else — performed the action; it agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun.
missions.literal: The president himself signed this agreement.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: раз (m. noun, 'time/instance'; gen.pl. раз — zero ending). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | был (m.sg. past of быть) | там (adv. of location, 'there') | много (quantifier, 'many') | раз (m. noun, gen.pl., genitive after quantifier). After много and other quantifiers of indefinite amount, the counted noun goes into the genitive (pl. for count nouns); раз has the irregular zero gen.pl.
missions.literal: I've been there many times.

missions.phrase: Я учу русский, чтобы понимать фильмы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: чтобы (subord. conj., 'in order to/so that'; takes inf. or past). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | учу (1sg pres impf of учить, 'to study') | русский (adj. used as noun, m.acc.sg., direct object, 'Russian language') | чтобы (purpose conj.) | понимать (impf. inf., 'to understand'). When subjects of the main and subordinate clauses are the same, чтобы takes a bare infinitive — no past-tense form needed.
missions.literal: I'm learning Russian to understand films.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: два (cardinal numeral, m./n.; f. form две). Per-token: У (prep., + gen. for possessor) | меня (1sg pers. pron., gen.) | осталось (n.sg. past of остаться perf., refl., 'to remain'; n. agreement with paucal quant. subject) | два (numeral, m.nom.) | рубля (m. noun, gen.sg. of рубль after paucal numeral). Numerals 2/3/4 in the nominative trigger the genitive singular of the counted noun; past verbs typically agree in the neuter singular with such paucal subjects.
missions.literal: I have two rubles left.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: там (adv. of static location, 'there'; contrast туда 'to there'). Per-token: Поставь (2sg imp of поставить perf., 'to put upright') | сумку (f. noun, acc.sg. of сумка, direct object) | там (adv. of location, 'there') | у (prep., + gen. for proximity) | двери (f. noun, gen.sg. of дверь). У + genitive can mean 'near/by'; там specifies the existing spot where the bag should end up.
missions.literal: Put the bag there, by the door.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: чем (subord. conj. of comparison, 'than'; also instr. of что). Per-token: Брат (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | выше (comp. of высокий, indecl., predicate, 'taller') | ростом (m. noun, instr.sg. of рост, instr. of respect, 'in height') | чем (conj. of comparison) | сестра (f. noun, nom.sg., compared element in same case as the first). With comparatives, чем + nominative is the analytic comparison; alternatively сестры (genitive) without чем would also work.
missions.literal: My brother is taller than my sister.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: глаз (m. noun, 'eye'; gen.pl. глаз — zero ending; nom.pl. глаза). Per-token: У (prep., + gen. for possessor) | неё (3sg.f pers. pron., gen.) | ярко-голубые (compound adj., m.pl.nom., agrees with глаза) | глаза (m. pl. noun, nom.pl. of глаз, grammatical subject). Possession of body features uses у + gen. + nominative; hyphenated colour compounds are written with a single hyphen.
missions.literal: She has bright blue eyes.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: жизнь (f. noun, 'life'; soft-stem ь-declension). Per-token: Жизнь (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | в (prep., + prep. for location) | большом (adj., m.prep.sg., agrees with городе) | городе (m. noun, prep.sg. of город) | утомительна (short-form adj., f.sg., predicate). Short-form adjectives in -а agree with the f.sg. subject and serve as predicates with zero copula in the present.
missions.literal: Life in a big city is exhausting.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: первый (ordinal numeral, 'first'; declines as adjective). Per-token: Первый (ord. numeral, m.nom.sg., agrees with блин) | блин (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | всегда (adv. of frequency, 'always') | выходит (3sg pres impf of выходить, 'to come out') | комом (m. noun, instr.sg. of ком, 'lump'). This is a famous proverb meaning 'the first attempt is always rough'; выходить + instr. expresses 'turn out (as)'.
missions.literal: The first pancake always comes out lumpy.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: день (m. noun, 'day'; fleeting vowel: дня, дню etc.). Per-token: Сегодня (adv. of time, 'today') | прекрасный (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with день) | день (m. noun, nom.sg., subject of zero copula) | для (prep., + gen. for purpose) | прогулки (f. noun, gen.sg. of прогулка). The fleeting е in день drops in all oblique forms; для + genitive names the purpose.
missions.literal: Today is a wonderful day for a walk.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: тут (adv. of static location, 'here'; colloquial synonym of здесь). Per-token: Подожди (2sg imp of подождать perf., 'to wait a bit') | тут (adv. of location) | я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | скоро (adv. of time, 'soon') | вернусь (1sg fut. of вернуться perf., refl., 'to return'). Тут is slightly more colloquial than здесь but functionally identical; perfective подожди conveys a single bounded wait.
missions.literal: Wait here, I'll be back soon.

missions.phrase: Во сне я летал над городом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: во (variant of в before certain consonant clusters and fixed forms; + prep. or acc.). Per-token: Во (prep. variant, + prep. for static location) | сне (m. noun, prep.sg. of сон, with fleeting o) | я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | летал (m.sg. past impf of летать, indeterminate 'to fly around') | над (prep., + instr. for 'over/above') | городом (m. noun, instr.sg. of город). The variant во is required before сон because of the consonant cluster; над always takes the instrumental.
missions.literal: In my dream I was flying over the city.

missions.phrase: Ничто не сравнится с маминым борщом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: ничто (neg. pron., 'nothing'; nom., obl. ничего/ничему/ничем). Per-token: Ничто (neg. pron., nom.sg., subject) | не (neg. particle, obligatory with neg. pron.) | сравнится (3sg fut. of сравниться perf., refl., 'to compare/equal') | с (prep., + instr. for comparison) | маминым (poss. adj., m.instr.sg., agrees with борщом) | борщом (m. noun, instr.sg. of борщ). Negative pronouns require не on the verb (double negation); сравниться с + instrumental names what something is being compared to.
missions.literal: Nothing compares to Mum's borscht.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: потом (adv. of sequence, 'then/afterwards'). Per-token: Сначала (adv. of sequence, 'first') | поужинаем (1pl fut. of поужинать perf., 'to have dinner') | потом (adv. of sequence) | посмотрим (1pl fut. of посмотреть perf., 'to watch') | фильм (m. inan. noun, acc.sg., direct object). The сначала…потом frame neatly orders two sequential actions; both verbs are perfective because each is a single completed event.
missions.literal: First we'll have dinner, then we'll watch a film.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: очень (adv. of degree, 'very (much)'). Per-token: Мне (1sg pers. pron., dat., experiencer) | очень (adv. of degree) | нравится (3sg pres impf of нравиться, refl., 'to please') | эта (dem. pron., f.nom.sg., agrees with песня) | песня (f. noun, nom.sg., grammatical subject). With нравиться the liker is dative and the liked thing is nominative subject; очень modifies the verb to mean 'really like'.
missions.literal: I really like this song.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: со (variant of с before certain consonant clusters; + instr. or gen.). Per-token: Со (prep. variant, + instr.) | мной (1sg pers. pron., instr.) | произошла (f.sg. past of произойти perf., 'to occur') | странная (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with история) | история (f. noun, nom.sg., subject). The variant со is mandatory before мной for euphony; произойти с + instrumental = 'to happen to someone'.
missions.literal: A strange thing happened to me.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: хотеть (impf. inf., 'to want'; irreg. mixed conjugation: хочу, хочешь, хочет, хотим…). Per-token: Не (neg. particle) | хочу (1sg pres impf of хотеть) | никого (neg. pron., gen./acc.sg. of никто, direct object) | видеть (impf. inf., 'to see') | сегодня (adv. of time). Negative pronouns animate take the acc.=gen. form; the negated transitive verb видеть takes the genitive of the negated object.
missions.literal: I don't want to see anyone today.

missions.phrase: Не знаю, придёт ли он сегодня.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: ли (interrog./yes-no particle, second-position in embedded questions). Per-token: Не (neg. particle) | знаю (1sg pres impf of знать) | придёт (3sg fut. of прийти perf., 'to arrive') | ли (yes-no particle following the focused verb) | он (3sg.m pers. pron., nom.) | сегодня (adv. of time). In indirect yes-no questions, the focused (questioned) word fronts and ли attaches to it; the rest of the clause follows.
missions.literal: I don't know whether he'll come today.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: при (prep.; + prep. = 'at/upon/in the presence of/during'). Per-token: При (prep., + prep. for the occasion) | входе (m. noun, prep.sg. of вход, 'entry') | покажите (2pl/formal imp of показать perf., 'to show') | свой (refl. poss. pron., m.acc.sg.=nom. for inanimate, agrees with паспорт) | паспорт (m. inan. noun, acc.sg., direct object). При + prep. of a deverbal noun ('upon entering') is a frequent way to express the time/circumstance of an action without a full clause.
missions.literal: Show your passport upon entry.

missions.phrase: Эта мысль не выходит из головы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: голова (f. noun, 'head'; acc.sg. голову with stress shift). Per-token: Эта (dem. pron., f.nom.sg., agrees with мысль) | мысль (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | не (neg. particle) | выходит (3sg pres impf of выходить, 'to go out') | из (prep., + gen. for source) | головы (f. noun, gen.sg. of голова). Idiomatic 'не выходит из головы' = 'can't get it out of my head'; из + genitive marks the container being exited.
missions.literal: This thought won't leave my head.

missions.phrase: Мне надо срочно поговорить с тобой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: надо (impers. pred., 'need/must'; synonym of нужно, slightly more colloquial). Per-token: Мне (1sg pers. pron., dat., experiencer) | надо (impers. pred.) | срочно (adv. of urgency, 'urgently') | поговорить (perf. inf., 'to have a talk') | с (prep., + instr.) | тобой (2sg pers. pron., instr.). Надо + inf. uses the dative for the person who must act; perfective поговорить = a single bounded conversation, not a habit.
missions.literal: I urgently need to talk to you.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: без (prep.; + gen. = 'without'). Per-token: Без (prep., + gen. of absence) | сахара (m. noun, gen.sg. of сахар, partitive-like 'without any sugar') | кофе (m. indecl. noun, nom.sg., subject) | слишком (adv. of degree, 'too') | горький (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with кофе, predicate). Без always governs the genitive; кофе is an indeclinable masculine noun in standard Russian.
missions.literal: Without sugar, the coffee is too bitter.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: видеть (impf. inf., 'to see'; perf. counterpart увидеть for the moment of perception). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | давно (adv. of time, 'for a long time') | тебя (2sg pers. pron., gen./acc., here acc.; gen. form of negation also possible) | не (neg. particle) | видел (m.sg. past impf of видеть). Imperfective past with не + давно is the standard way to say 'haven't seen you for ages'; the personal pronoun keeps its anim. acc. = gen. form.
missions.literal: I haven't seen you in ages.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: идти (impf. inf., 'to go on foot (determinate)'; also used metaphorically for rain/snow/time). Per-token: Дождь (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | идёт (3sg pres impf of идти) | уже (adv. of time, 'already') | третий (ord. numeral, m.acc.sg.=nom. for inanimate, agrees with день) | день (m. inan. noun, acc.sg., acc. of duration). 'Дождь идёт' is the standard idiom for 'it's raining'; the bare accusative expresses the duration ('for a third day now').
missions.literal: It's been raining for three days already.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: теперь (adv. of time, 'now (in contrast to before)'). Per-token: Раньше (adv. of time, 'previously') | я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | курил (m.sg. past impf of курить, 'to smoke') | теперь (adv. of time) | бросил (m.sg. past of бросить perf., 'to quit/throw'). Теперь contrasts the present with an explicit past situation, whereas сейчас just means 'at this moment'; aspect contrast (impf. habit vs. perf. one-off quitting) is on display here.
missions.literal: I used to smoke, now I've quit.

missions.phrase: Брат любит шахматы, и я тоже.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: тоже (adv./particle, 'also/too'; contrast with также). Per-token: Брат (m. noun, nom.sg., subject of first clause) | любит (3sg pres impf of любить) | шахматы (m. pl. tantum, acc.pl.=nom., direct object) | и (coord. conj.) | я (1sg pers. pron., nom., subject of second clause) | тоже (additive particle, verb elided). Тоже adds a new subject doing the same action ('me too'); the verb is normally elided in such tag clauses.
missions.literal: My brother loves chess, and so do I.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: стоять (impf. inf., 'to stand/be in upright position'; perf. постоять 'stand a while'). Per-token: Не (neg. particle) | стой (2sg imp of стоять) | на (prep., + prep. for location) | сквозняке (m. noun, prep.sg. of сквозняк, 'draught') | простудишься (2sg fut. of простудиться perf., refl., 'to catch a cold'). Imperfective imperative under не warns against an ongoing state; the bare future clause names the feared consequence.
missions.literal: Don't stand in the draught, you'll catch a cold.

missions.phrase: Мой лучший друг живёт в Берлине.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: друг (m. anim. noun, 'friend'; suppletive pl. друзья, gen.pl. друзей). Per-token: Мой (poss. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with друг) | лучший (adj., superlative of хороший, m.nom.sg., agrees with друг) | друг (m. anim. noun, nom.sg., subject) | живёт (3sg pres impf of жить) | в (prep., + prep. for location) | Берлине (m. proper noun, prep.sg. of Берлин). Лучший is a synthetic superlative; жить в + prep. is the canonical 'live in' construction.
missions.literal: My best friend lives in Berlin.

missions.phrase: После работы я сразу поеду домой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: дом (m. noun, 'house/home'; adv. form домой = 'homewards', дома = 'at home'). Per-token: После (prep., + gen. for 'after') | работы (f. noun, gen.sg. of работа) | я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | сразу (adv. of immediacy, 'right away') | поеду (1sg fut. of поехать perf., 'to set off by transport') | домой (adv. of direction, 'home(wards)'). Russian distinguishes three frozen forms of дом: дома (location), домой (direction to), из дома (direction from).
missions.literal: After work I'll head straight home.

missions.phrase: Извини, сейчас я не могу говорить.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: сейчас (adv., 'now/right now'; time adverb). Per-token: Извини (2sg imp. of извинить, perf., 'sorry/excuse me') | сейчас (adv., temporal, 'now') | я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | не (negative particle) | могу (1sg pres. of мочь, impf., 'I can') | говорить (impf. inf., 'to talk'). Modal могу + не takes a bare imperfective infinitive; сейчас anchors the inability to the present moment.
missions.literal: Sorry, I can't talk right now.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: можно (impersonal predicative, 'one may/it is permitted'; takes dat. of person + inf.). Per-token: Можно (impers. pred., 'may') | мне (1sg pers. pron., dat., experiencer) | открыть (perf. inf. of открыть, 'to open') | это (dem. pron., n.acc.sg., agrees with окно) | окно (n. noun, acc.sg., direct object of открыть). Polite permission frame: можно + dat. + perf. inf.; perfective for the single act of opening.
missions.literal: May I open this window?

missions.phrase: После работы мы пойдём в кафе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: после (prep., + gen., 'after'). Per-token: После (prep., + gen., temporal) | работы (f. noun, gen.sg. of работа, governed by после) | мы (1pl pers. pron., nom.) | пойдём (1pl fut. of пойти, perf., 'we will go') | в (prep., + acc. for direction) | кафе (n. noun, indeclinable, acc.sg., goal of motion). Perfective пойти forms a synthetic future; в + acc. marks destination.
missions.literal: After work we'll go to a cafe.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: слово (n. noun, nom./acc.sg., 'word'). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | не (neg. particle) | помню (1sg pres. of помнить, impf., 'I remember') | это (dem. pron./adj., n.acc.sg., agrees with слово) | слово (n. noun, acc.sg., direct object). Помнить takes the accusative for the thing remembered; neuter это/слово look the same in nom and acc.
missions.literal: I don't remember this word.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: здесь (adv. of location, 'here'; static location only). Per-token: Подожди (2sg imp. of подождать, perf., 'wait') | меня (1sg pers. pron., acc./gen.) | здесь (loc. adv.) | пожалуйста (politeness particle, 'please'). Подождать governs the accusative of the person waited for; здесь is purely locative (not directional — that would be сюда).
missions.literal: Wait for me here, please.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: думать (impf. verb, 'to think'; pair: подумать). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | люблю (1sg pres. of любить, impf., 'I love') | думать (impf. inf.) | о (prep., + prep. case, topic 'about') | будущем (adj. used as n. noun, prep.sg., 'the future'). Любить + impf. infinitive expresses habitual liking of an activity; думать о governs the prepositional.
missions.literal: I love thinking about the future.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: место (n. noun, 'place/room/space'). Per-token: Здесь (loc. adv.) | нет (negative existential, 'there is no', + gen.) | места (n. noun, gen.sg. of место, governed by нет) | для (prep., + gen., 'for') | машины (f. noun, gen.sg. of машина, governed by для). Existential нет requires the genitive of what is absent; для also takes gen.
missions.literal: There's no room here for a car.

missions.phrase: Я хочу спросить тебя о работе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: спросить (perf. verb, 'to ask a question'; impf. спрашивать). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | хочу (1sg pres. of хотеть, impf., 'I want') | спросить (perf. inf.) | тебя (2sg pers. pron., acc.) | о (prep., + prep., topic) | работе (f. noun, prep.sg. of работа). Спросить кого-то о чём-то: person in accusative, topic in prepositional after о.
missions.literal: I want to ask you about work.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: через (prep., + acc., 'through/across'; with time: 'in X time'). Per-token: Поезд (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | приедет (3sg fut. of приехать, perf., 'will arrive') | через (prep., + acc., temporal 'in') | десять (numeral, acc., 'ten') | минут (f. noun, gen.pl. of минута, required after numerals 5+). After numerals 5 and above the counted noun takes genitive plural.
missions.literal: The train will arrive in ten minutes.

missions.phrase: У неё доброе и красивое лицо.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: лицо (n. noun, 'face'; also 'person' in formal contexts). Per-token: У (prep., + gen., possessor) | неё (3sg.f pers. pron., gen. with prosthetic н- after preposition) | доброе (adj., n.nom.sg., agrees with лицо) | и (coord. conj., 'and') | красивое (adj., n.nom.sg., agrees with лицо) | лицо (n. noun, nom.sg., subject of implied 'is'). У + gen. is the standard Russian possessive construction; both adjectives agree neuter sg.
missions.literal: She has a kind and beautiful face.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: что (interr./rel. pron., 'what'; here acc. = nom. for inanimate). Per-token: Что (interr. pron., acc.sg., direct object) | ты (2sg pers. pron., nom.) | делаешь (2sg pres. of делать, impf., 'you do/are doing') | сегодня (adv., 'today') | вечером (m. noun, instr.sg. of вечер, time adverbial 'in the evening'). Instrumental of time-of-day nouns expresses 'in the X' without a preposition.
missions.literal: What are you doing this evening?

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: тогда (adv., 'then'; consequential or temporal). Per-token: Если (sub. conj., 'if') | ты (2sg pers. pron., nom.) | готов (short-form adj., m.sg., predicative, 'ready') | тогда (consequential adv., 'then/in that case') | пойдём (1pl fut./hortative of пойти, perf., 'let's go'). Если...тогда is a conditional-consequence pair; пойдём without a subject pronoun reads as an inclusive 'let's'.
missions.literal: If you're ready, then let's go.

missions.phrase: Ты ведь знаешь, что это правда.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: ведь (modal particle, 'after all/you know'; appeals to shared knowledge). Per-token: Ты (2sg pers. pron., nom.) | ведь (modal particle) | знаешь (2sg pres. of знать, impf., 'you know') | что (sub. conj., 'that') | это (dem. pron., n.nom.sg., subject) | правда (f. noun, nom.sg., predicate nominative). Ведь softens an assertion by implying the listener already agrees; что here is a complementizer, not the interrogative.
missions.literal: You know, after all, that it's true.

missions.phrase: Он мой хороший друг с детства.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: хороший (adj., 'good'; soft-stem ending after ш). Per-token: Он (3sg.m pers. pron., nom.) | мой (poss. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with друг) | хороший (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with друг) | друг (m. noun, nom.sg., predicate) | с (prep., + gen., 'since/from') | детства (n. noun, gen.sg. of детство). С + gen. of a time noun marks a starting point ('since childhood').
missions.literal: He's been my good friend since childhood.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: каждый (det. pron., 'every/each'; declines like a hard adj.). Per-token: Каждый (det. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with ребёнок) | ребёнок (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | мечтает (3sg pres. of мечтать, impf., 'dreams') | о (prep., + prep., topic) | подарках (m. noun, prep.pl. of подарок). Каждый takes a singular noun even though the meaning is universal; мечтать о governs prepositional.
missions.literal: Every child dreams about presents.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: новый (adj., 'new'; hard-stem). Per-token: Мы (1pl pers. pron., nom.) | купили (past pl. of купить, perf., 'bought') | новый (adj., m.acc.sg. inan. = nom., agrees with телефон) | телефон (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | вчера (time adv., 'yesterday'). Inanimate masculine accusative is identical to nominative; perfective past marks a completed event.
missions.literal: We bought a new phone yesterday.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: жить (impf. verb, 'to live'; irreg. stem жив-). Per-token: Мои (poss. pron., pl.nom., agrees with родители) | родители (m. noun, nom.pl. of родитель) | живут (3pl pres. of жить, impf., 'they live') | в (prep., + prep. for static location) | деревне (f. noun, prep.sg. of деревня). Жить uses the stem жив- in present (живу, живёшь, живут).
missions.literal: My parents live in a village.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: должный (adj., 'due/proper'; bookish, common in fixed phrases like должное уважение/внимание). Per-token: Мы (1pl pers. pron., nom.) | окажем (1pl fut. of оказать, perf., 'we will render') | вам (2pl/polite pers. pron., dat.) | должное (adj., n.acc.sg., agrees with уважение) | уважение (n. noun, acc.sg., direct object). Оказать уважение/внимание is an idiomatic collocation; the recipient takes dative.
missions.literal: We will show you proper respect.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: смотреть (impf. verb, 'to watch/look'; pair: посмотреть). Per-token: Мы (1pl pers. pron., nom.) | любим (1pl pres. of любить, impf., 'we love') | смотреть (impf. inf.) | фильмы (m. noun, acc.pl. of фильм; inan. acc.pl. = nom.pl.) | вечером (m. noun, instr.sg. of вечер, time adverbial). Любить + impf. inf. = habitual enjoyment; смотреть takes a direct accusative for what's watched.
missions.literal: We love watching films in the evening.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: почему (interr. adv., 'why'). Per-token: Почему (interr. adv.) | ты (2sg pers. pron., nom.) | так (adv. of degree, 'so') | поздно (adv., 'late') | пришёл (m.sg. past of прийти, perf., 'arrived'). Past tense of прийти agrees with the subject's gender; так intensifies the following adverb.
missions.literal: Why did you come so late?

missions.phrase: Я устал, потому что много работал.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: потому (adv. used with что as causal conj. 'because'). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | устал (m.sg. past of устать, perf., 'got tired') | потому (causal adv.) | что (sub. conj., here part of compound потому что) | много (quantifier adv., 'a lot') | работал (m.sg. past of работать, impf., 'was working'). Потому что is the standard causal connector; the comma goes between the clauses or before что depending on emphasis.
missions.literal: I'm tired because I worked a lot.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: сторона (f. noun, 'side'). Per-token: С (prep., + gen., 'from') | другой (adj., f.gen.sg., agrees with стороны) | стороны (f. noun, gen.sg. of сторона) | он (3sg.m pers. pron., nom.) | прав (short-form adj., m.sg., predicative, 'right/correct'). 'С другой стороны' is the fixed discourse marker 'on the other hand'; short-form прав is the predicative way to say someone is right.
missions.literal: On the other hand, he's right.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: просто (adv./particle, 'simply/just'). Per-token: Это (dem. pron., n.nom.sg., subject) | просто (intensifying particle, 'simply') | невозможно (impers. pred., 'impossible') | понять (perf. inf. of понять, 'to understand'). Impersonal predicative невозможно + inf. is a common 'it is impossible to' construction; просто intensifies the predicate.
missions.literal: It's simply impossible to understand.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: нога (f. noun, 'leg/foot'; stress shifts in plural). Per-token: У (prep., + gen., possessor) | меня (1sg pers. pron., gen.) | болит (3sg pres. of болеть, impf., 'hurts') | правая (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with нога) | нога (f. noun, nom.sg., grammatical subject of болит). Pain construction: 'у X болит Y', literally 'at X hurts Y'; the body part is nominative.
missions.literal: My right leg hurts.

missions.phrase: Дети сидят за столом и читают.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: сидеть (impf. verb, 'to sit/be sitting'; stative). Per-token: Дети (n.→pl. noun, nom.pl. of ребёнок; suppletive) | сидят (3pl pres. of сидеть, impf., 'are sitting') | за (prep., + instr. for static 'behind/at') | столом (m. noun, instr.sg. of стол) | и (coord. conj.) | читают (3pl pres. of читать, impf., 'are reading'). 'Сидеть за столом' = 'to sit at a table'; за + instr. for static position.
missions.literal: The children are sitting at the table reading.

missions.phrase: Я не могу понять твой ответ.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: понять (perf. verb, 'to understand/grasp'; impf. понимать). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | не (neg. particle) | могу (1sg pres. of мочь, impf., 'I can') | понять (perf. inf.) | твой (poss. pron., m.acc.sg. inan. = nom., agrees with ответ) | ответ (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object). Perfective понять after мочь focuses on achieving understanding as a single act; with negation it implies inability to grasp.
missions.literal: I can't understand your answer.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: иметь (impf. verb, 'to have'; formal — colloquial Russian prefers у + gen.). Per-token: Каждый (det. pron., m.nom.sg., here substantivised 'everyone') | должен (short-form adj., m.sg., predicative modal 'must') | иметь (impf. inf.) | право (n. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | голоса (m. noun, gen.sg. of голос, dependent gen. 'of vote'). Должен + inf. = obligation; 'право голоса' is a fixed legal collocation.
missions.literal: Everyone must have the right to vote.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: конечный (adj., 'final/ultimate'). Per-token: Это (dem. pron., n.nom.sg., subject) | конечный (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with результат) | результат (m. noun, nom.sg., predicate nominative) | нашей (poss. pron., f.gen.sg., agrees with работы) | работы (f. noun, gen.sg., possessive 'of our work'). The copula is zero in present tense; the predicate stays in nominative.
missions.literal: This is the final result of our work.

missions.phrase: Что мне делать в этой ситуации?
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: делать (impf. verb, 'to do/make'; pair: сделать). Per-token: Что (interr. pron., acc.sg., direct object) | мне (1sg pers. pron., dat., logical subject of impers. construction) | делать (impf. inf.) | в (prep., + prep. for static location) | этой (dem. pron., f.prep.sg., agrees with ситуации) | ситуации (f. noun, prep.sg. of ситуация). Dative + infinitive expresses deliberative 'what am I to do'; impf. fits an open-ended consideration.
missions.literal: What am I to do in this situation?

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: вдруг (adv., 'suddenly'; narrative marker). Per-token: Вдруг (adv. of manner/time, 'suddenly') | пошёл (m.sg. past of пойти, perf., 'started/began') | сильный (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with дождь) | дождь (m. noun, nom.sg., subject). With weather, пойти means 'to start (raining/snowing)'; perfective past marks the inception.
missions.literal: Suddenly it started raining hard.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: над (prep., + instr., 'above/over'). Per-token: Над (prep., + instr.) | городом (m. noun, instr.sg. of город) | летят (3pl pres. of лететь, impf., 'are flying') | большие (adj., pl.nom., agrees with птицы) | птицы (f. noun, nom.pl. of птица, subject). Над always takes instrumental for the location below the thing referenced.
missions.literal: Large birds are flying over the city.

missions.phrase: Не забудь взять зонт с собой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: взять (perf. verb, 'to take'; impf. брать; suppletive aspectual pair). Per-token: Не (neg. particle) | забудь (2sg imp. of забыть, perf., 'forget') | взять (perf. inf.) | зонт (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | с (prep., + instr., 'with') | собой (refl. pron., instr.). 'Взять с собой' = 'to take along'; negative imperative with perfective expresses a one-time warning.
missions.literal: Don't forget to take an umbrella with you.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: никто (neg. pron., 'nobody'; requires double negation with не). Per-token: Никто (neg. pron., nom.sg., subject) | не (neg. particle, obligatory) | знает (3sg pres. of знать, impf., 'knows') | правильный (adj., m.acc.sg. inan. = nom., agrees with ответ) | ответ (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object). Russian negation is concord-based: ни-pronouns require не on the verb.
missions.literal: Nobody knows the right answer.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: сделать (perf. verb, 'to do/complete'; impf. делать). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | обещаю (1sg pres. of обещать, impf., 'I promise') | сделать (perf. inf.) | всё (det. pron., n.acc.sg., 'everything') | вовремя (adv., 'on time'). Promising a single completed result calls for the perfective infinitive; всё here is the substantivised 'everything'.
missions.literal: I promise to get it all done on time.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: дверь (f. noun, 'door'; 3rd declension, ends in soft sign). Per-token: Закрой (2sg imp. of закрыть, perf., 'close') | дверь (f. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | пожалуйста (politeness particle) | холодно (impers. pred., 'it's cold'). Inanimate fem. acc. of -ь nouns is identical to nominative; impersonal холодно expresses a state without a subject.
missions.literal: Close the door, please, it's cold.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: перед (prep., + instr., 'before/in front of'). Per-token: Перед (prep., + instr., temporal) | сном (m. noun, instr.sg. of сон) | я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | читаю (1sg pres. of читать, impf., 'I read') | книгу (f. noun, acc.sg. of книга, direct object). Перед + instr. handles both spatial 'in front of' and temporal 'before'; impf. reads as habitual.
missions.literal: Before bed I read a book.

missions.phrase: Я нашёл нужный файл на компьютере.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: нужный (adj., 'needed/the right'). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | нашёл (m.sg. past of найти, perf., 'found') | нужный (adj., m.acc.sg. inan. = nom., agrees with файл) | файл (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | на (prep., + prep. for static location) | компьютере (m. noun, prep.sg. of компьютер). Note нужный (the adj.) vs нужно/нужен (predicatives); here the adj. modifies the noun directly.
missions.literal: I found the right file on the computer.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: понимать (impf. verb, 'to understand'; perf. понять). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | начинаю (1sg pres. of начинать, impf., 'I am starting') | понимать (impf. inf.) | русский (adj., m.acc.sg. inan. = nom., agrees with язык) | язык (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object). Phase verbs like начинать/продолжать/кончать govern the imperfective infinitive only — this is a hard grammar rule.
missions.literal: I'm starting to understand Russian.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: казаться (impf. refl. verb, 'to seem'; perf. показаться). Per-token: Мне (1sg pers. pron., dat., experiencer) | кажется (3sg pres. of казаться, impf., refl., 'it seems') | что (sub. conj., 'that') | он (3sg.m pers. pron., nom.) | прав (short-form adj., m.sg., predicative). Impersonal 'мне кажется' uses dative for the experiencer; the postfix -ся makes the verb reflexive.
missions.literal: It seems to me that he's right.

missions.phrase: Моя работа очень интересная и трудная.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: работа (f. noun, 'work/job'). Per-token: Моя (poss. pron., f.nom.sg., agrees with работа) | работа (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | очень (adv. of degree, 'very') | интересная (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with работа) | и (coord. conj.) | трудная (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with работа). Predicate adjectives in present tense stay in nominative (zero copula).
missions.literal: My job is very interesting and hard.

missions.phrase: У меня три брата и сестра.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: три (cardinal numeral, 'three'; takes gen.sg. of counted noun). Per-token: У (prep., + gen.) | меня (1sg pers. pron., gen.) | три (num., nom., 'three') | брата (m. noun, gen.sg. of брат, required after 2/3/4 in paucal) | и (coord. conj.) | сестра (f. noun, nom.sg., second possession). After 2, 3, 4 (and compounds) Russian uses genitive singular (the 'paucal' form); after 5+ it switches to genitive plural.
missions.literal: I have three brothers and a sister.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: ваш (poss. pron., 2pl/polite 'your'; declines like an adj.). Per-token: Ваш (poss. pron., m.acc.sg. inan. = nom., agrees with паспорт) | паспорт (m. noun, acc.sg., implied request object) | пожалуйста (politeness particle) | и (coord. conj.) | билет (m. noun, acc.sg., second object). Elliptical request — the verb (e.g. покажите/дайте) is omitted but understood; objects stay accusative.
missions.literal: Your passport, please, and ticket.

missions.phrase: Не так уж это и сложно.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: уж (modal particle, intensifier; emphatic variant of уже in some uses, often softens or strengthens). Per-token: Не (neg. particle) | так (adv. of degree) | уж (modal particle, emphatic) | это (dem. pron., n.nom.sg., subject) | и (additive particle here, 'really') | сложно (impers. pred., 'difficult'). 'Не так уж и' is a fixed idiomatic frame meaning 'not so very/not really all that'.
missions.literal: It's not really all that hard.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: земля (f. noun, 'earth/land/Earth'; capitalised when the planet). Per-token: Земля (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | вращается (3sg pres. of вращаться, impf., refl., 'rotates') | вокруг (prep., + gen., 'around') | Солнца (n. noun, gen.sg. of Солнце, governed by вокруг). Reflexive -ся here marks an intransitive process; вокруг always governs the genitive.
missions.literal: The Earth revolves around the Sun.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: конец (m. noun, 'end'; fleeting vowel, gen. конца). Per-token: В (prep., + prep. for static location) | конце (m. noun, prep.sg. of конец, fleeting е drops) | фильма (m. noun, gen.sg. of фильм, possessive 'of the film') | все (det. pron., pl.nom., 'everyone') | плакали (past pl. of плакать, impf., 'were crying'). 'В конце' is the standard temporal frame 'at the end of'; impf. past for a continuous action.
missions.literal: At the end of the movie everyone was crying.

missions.phrase: У меня есть несколько важных вопросов.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: несколько (indef. quantifier, 'several/a few'; governs gen.pl.). Per-token: У (prep., + gen.) | меня (1sg pers. pron., gen.) | есть (3sg pres. of быть, existential, 'there is/has') | несколько (quant., nom., 'several') | важных (adj., gen.pl., agrees with вопросов) | вопросов (m. noun, gen.pl. of вопрос, governed by несколько). Indefinite quantifiers like несколько/много/мало always take genitive plural for count nouns.
missions.literal: I have several important questions.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: час (m. noun, 'hour'; numeric forms: один час, два часа, пять часов). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | ждал (m.sg. past of ждать, impf., 'was waiting') | тебя (2sg pers. pron., acc./gen.) | целый (adj., m.acc.sg. inan. = nom., agrees with час) | час (m. noun, acc.sg., duration adverbial). Duration of time in Russian takes bare accusative (no preposition); ждать of definite people takes accusative.
missions.literal: I waited for you a whole hour.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: голос (m. noun, 'voice'; nom.pl. голоса with stress shift). Per-token: У (prep., + gen., possessor) | певицы (f. noun, gen.sg. of певица) | очень (adv. of degree) | красивый (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with голос) | голос (m. noun, nom.sg., grammatical subject of zero-copula clause). The У + gen. possessive frame plus a nominative subject is the standard way to describe attributes.
missions.literal: The singer has a very beautiful voice.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: город (m. noun, 'city/town'; nom.pl. города with stress shift). Per-token: Наш (poss. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with город) | город (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | стоит (3sg pres. of стоять, impf., 'stands/is located') | на (prep., + prep. for static location) | реке (f. noun, prep.sg. of река). Стоять is the conventional verb for the location of buildings/settlements; на + prep. for being on a surface or river.
missions.literal: Our city sits on a river.

missions.phrase: Это был последний поезд на сегодня.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: последний (adj., 'last/final'; soft-stem). Per-token: Это (dem. pron., n.nom.sg., subject pronoun) | был (m.sg. past of быть, 'was', agrees with предикат поезд) | последний (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with поезд) | поезд (m. noun, nom.sg., predicate nominative) | на (prep., + acc. for time period 'for') | сегодня (adv./noun, 'today'). With copular это был the gender of был matches the predicate noun; на + acc. of a time word means 'for (a period)'.
missions.literal: That was the last train for today.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: пока (conj./adv., 'while/until'; also informal 'bye'). Per-token: Пока (sub. conj., 'while') | я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | готовлю (1sg pres. of готовить, impf., 'I am preparing') | ужин (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | отдохни (2sg imp. of отдохнуть, perf., 'rest'). Пока (while) takes the imperfective for simultaneous ongoing action in the subordinate clause.
missions.literal: While I cook dinner, take a rest.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: хорошо (adv., 'well'; also impers. pred. 'good/fine'). Per-token: Она (3sg.f pers. pron., nom.) | хорошо (manner adv.) | говорит (3sg pres. of говорить, impf., 'speaks') | по-английски (manner adv., 'in English', по- + adverbial -ски). The hyphenated по-...-ски pattern derives language-manner adverbs.
missions.literal: She speaks English well.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: давать (impf. verb, 'to give'; perf. дать; irregular present даю/даёшь/дают). Per-token: Учитель (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | любит (3sg pres. of любить, impf., 'loves') | давать (impf. inf., habitual after любить) | сложные (adj., pl.acc., agrees with задания) | задания (n. noun, acc.pl. of задание, direct object). Inanimate neut. acc.pl. = nom.pl.; любить + impf. inf. for habitual preferences.
missions.literal: The teacher loves giving hard assignments.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: вода (f. noun, 'water'; mass noun, stress shift in acc.sg. воду). Per-token: В (prep., + prep. for static location) | реке (f. noun, prep.sg. of река) | очень (adv. of degree) | холодная (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with вода) | вода (f. noun, nom.sg., subject of zero-copula clause). Existential/locative pattern: place phrase + adjective + noun in nominative.
missions.literal: The water in the river is very cold.

missions.phrase: Эта задача более сложная, чем та.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: более (adv., 'more'; analytic comparative marker). Per-token: Эта (dem. pron., f.nom.sg., agrees with задача) | задача (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | более (comparative adv.) | сложная (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with задача) | чем (comp. conj., 'than') | та (dem. pron., f.nom.sg., 'that one'). Analytic comparative 'более + positive adj.' is an alternative to the synthetic form (сложнее); чем introduces the standard of comparison.
missions.literal: This task is more difficult than that one.

missions.phrase: Хотя было поздно, мы продолжили работу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: хотя (sub. conj., 'although/even though'). Per-token: Хотя (concessive conj.) | было (n.sg. past of быть, used with impers. pred.) | поздно (impers. pred., 'late') | мы (1pl pers. pron., nom.) | продолжили (past pl. of продолжить, perf., 'continued') | работу (f. noun, acc.sg. of работа, direct object). Impersonal predicatives like поздно take neuter было in the past; хотя sets up a concessive contrast.
missions.literal: Although it was late, we kept working.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: всегда (adv. of frequency, 'always'). Per-token: Она (3sg.f pers. pron., nom.) | всегда (freq. adv.) | опаздывает (3sg pres. of опаздывать, impf., 'is late') | на (prep., + acc. for goal) | встречи (f. noun, acc.pl. of встреча, direct object). 'Опаздывать на' + acc. = 'to be late for'; impf. is mandatory with всегда (habitual).
missions.literal: She's always late for meetings.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: второй (ordinal num., 'second'; declines like a soft-stem adj.). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | живу (1sg pres. of жить, impf., 'I live') | на (prep., + prep. for static location, used with этаж) | втором (ord. num., m.prep.sg., agrees with этаже) | этаже (m. noun, prep.sg. of этаж). Floors of buildings take на + prepositional in Russian, not в.
missions.literal: I live on the second floor.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: куда (interr. adv., 'where to'; directional, vs. где = static). Per-token: Куда (dir. interr. adv.) | ты (2sg pers. pron., nom.) | идёшь (2sg pres. of идти, impf., 'are going') | так (adv. of degree) | рано (adv., 'early'). Russian distinguishes куда (motion towards) from где (static location); идти is the unidirectional going-on-foot verb.
missions.literal: Where are you going so early?

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: пойти (perf. verb, 'to set off/go'; impf. counterpart идти + suppletive). Per-token: Давай (hortative particle, from давать) | пойдём (1pl fut. of пойти, perf., 'let's go') | в (prep., + acc. for direction) | кино (n. noun, indeclinable, acc.sg., goal) | сегодня (time adv., 'today'). Давай + 1pl perfective future is the standard 'let's' construction.
