Per-token: Моя (poss. pron., f.nom.sg., agrees with семья) | семья (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | живёт (3sg pres. of жить) | в (prep., + prep. for static location) | маленьком (adj., m.prep.sg., agrees with городе) | городе (m. noun, prep.sg. of город). Singular semantic-collective nouns like семья take singular verbs in Russian.
missions.literal: My family lives in a small town.

missions.phrase: Я уже час ищу свои ключи.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: искать (impf. verb, 'to look for/search'; ищу́, и́щешь, governs acc. for concrete objects). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | уже (adv., 'already') | час (m. noun, acc.sg., duration) | ищу (1sg pres. of искать) | свои (refl. poss. pron., m.acc.pl., agrees with ключи) | ключи (m. noun, acc.pl. of ключ). Свой is preferred over мой when the possessor coincides with the subject.
missions.literal: I've been looking for my keys for an hour already.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: генерал (m. anim. noun, 'general'; nom./acc. distinguished by animacy). Per-token: Молодой (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with генерал) | генерал (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | отдал (perf. past m.sg. of отдать, 'to give/issue') | приказ (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | солдатам (m. noun, dat.pl. of солдат, indirect object). Отдать приказ кому — fixed phrase for issuing an order to someone.
missions.literal: The young general gave the soldiers an order.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: момент (m. noun, 'moment'; nom./acc.sg.). Per-token: В (prep., + acc. for point in time) | этот (dem. pron., m.acc.sg., agrees with момент) | момент (m. noun, acc.sg., time expression) | зазвонил (perf. past m.sg. of зазвонить, 'to start ringing') | телефон (m. noun, nom.sg., subject). Inceptive prefix за- conveys the abrupt onset of an action.
missions.literal: At that moment the phone started ringing.

missions.phrase: У него десять рублей в кошельке.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: десять (cardinal numeral, 'ten'; governs gen.pl.). Per-token: У (prep., + gen. for possession) | него (3sg.m pers. pron., gen.) | десять (numeral, nom., grammatical subject) | рублей (m. noun, gen.pl. of рубль, after numeral 5+) | в (prep., + prep. for location) | кошельке (m. noun, prep.sg. of кошелёк). Numerals 5–20 require the genitive plural of the counted noun.
missions.literal: He has ten rubles in his wallet.

missions.phrase: Завтра я хочу начать новую жизнь.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: начать (perf. verb, 'to begin/start'; impf. начинать). Per-token: Завтра (adv., 'tomorrow') | я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | хочу (1sg pres. of хотеть) | начать (perf. inf., complement) | новую (adj., f.acc.sg., agrees with жизнь) | жизнь (f. noun, acc.sg., direct object). Perfective infinitive signals a single intended new beginning.
missions.literal: Tomorrow I want to start a new life.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: следующий (adj., 'next/following'; derived from следовать). Per-token: На (prep., + prep. for time expressions like неделе) | следующей (adj., f.prep.sg., agrees with неделе) | неделе (f. noun, prep.sg. of неделя) | будет (3sg fut. of быть) | экзамен (m. noun, nom.sg., subject). The future tense of быть is used to place an event in the future.
missions.literal: Next week there will be an exam.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: личный (adj., 'personal/private'; from лицо). Per-token: Это (dem. pron., n.nom.sg., copular subject) | мой (poss. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with дневник) | личный (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with дневник) | дневник (m. noun, nom.sg., predicate). Это used as an introducer is invariant and takes a nominative predicate.
missions.literal: This is my personal diary.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: труд (m. noun, 'labour/effort'; gen.sg. труда́). Per-token: Без (prep., + gen. for absence) | труда (m. noun, gen.sg. of труд) | не (neg. particle) | вытащишь (2sg fut. perf. of вытащить, gnomic use) | рыбку (f. noun, acc.sg. dim. of рыбка). Classic Russian proverb; 2sg future-perfective is used with a generic 'you'.
missions.literal: Without effort you won't pull a fish out.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: верить (impf. verb, 'to believe/trust'; governs dat. for trusting someone). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | не (neg. particle) | верю (1sg pres. of верить) | своим (refl. poss. pron., m.dat.pl., agrees with глазам) | глазам (m. noun, dat.pl. of глаз). Верить кому/чему takes the dative; here a set expression for disbelief.
missions.literal: I can't believe my eyes.

missions.phrase: Наша группа поёт в школьном хоре.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: группа (f. noun, 'group'; nom.sg.). Per-token: Наша (poss. pron., f.nom.sg., agrees with группа) | группа (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | поёт (3sg pres. of петь) | в (prep., + prep. for location) | школьном (adj., m.prep.sg., agrees with хоре) | хоре (m. noun, prep.sg. of хор). Collective subjects in Russian normally trigger singular agreement.
missions.literal: Our group sings in the school choir.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: немного (adv./quantifier, 'a little/a bit'; governs gen. when used as quantifier). Per-token: Подожди (perf. imp. 2sg of подождать) | немного (adv., manner/quantity) | я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | скоро (adv., 'soon') | вернусь (1sg fut. perf. of вернуться). With imperatives like подожди, немного functions adverbially meaning 'a little while'.
missions.literal: Wait a little, I'll be back soon.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: впрочем (discourse particle/conj., 'however/though'; introduces a concession). Per-token: Впрочем (parenth. word, discourse marker) | это (dem. pron., n.nom.sg., subject) | уже (adv., 'already') | неважно (predicative adv., 'unimportant'). Впрочем typically opens a sentence and is set off by a comma, softening or revising the previous claim.
missions.literal: Anyway, it doesn't matter anymore.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: видно (predicative/impers., 'visible/can be seen'; from видеть). Per-token: Отсюда (adv., 'from here') | хорошо (adv., 'well') | видно (predicative, impers. construction) | море (n. noun, acc.sg., logical object). In impersonal видно constructions, the visible thing stands in the accusative.
missions.literal: From here you can see the sea well.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: являться (impf. refl. verb, 'to be/constitute' formal copula; governs instr. for predicate). Per-token: Этот (dem. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with вопрос) | вопрос (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | является (3sg pres. of являться) | самым (superl. marker + adj., m.instr.sg.) | важным (adj., m.instr.sg., predicate). Являться is the formal-register copula and requires the instrumental for its complement.
missions.literal: This question is the most important one.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: муж (m. anim. noun, 'husband'; pl. мужья́). Per-token: Её (poss. pron., invariant, possessor) | муж (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | работает (3sg pres. of работать) | в (prep., + prep. for location) | банке (m. noun, prep.sg. of банк). Её is invariant for gender, number, and case and precedes the noun.
missions.literal: Her husband works at a bank.

missions.phrase: Разве ты не знал об этом?
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: разве (interrog. particle expressing surprise or doubt). Per-token: Разве (interrog. particle) | ты (2sg pers. pron., nom.) | не (neg. particle) | знал (impf. past m.sg. of знать) | об (variant of о, prep., + prep.) | этом (dem. pron., n.prep.sg.). Разве turns a statement into an incredulous yes/no question.
missions.literal: Didn't you really know about this?

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: движение (n. noun, 'movement/traffic'; nom.sg.). Per-token: На (prep., + prep. for location) | дороге (f. noun, prep.sg. of дорога) | сильное (adj., n.nom.sg., agrees with движение) | движение (n. noun, nom.sg., subject) | утром (n. noun, instr.sg. of утро, time adverbial). Bare instrumental of time words denotes the part of day during which something happens.
missions.literal: There's heavy traffic on the road in the morning.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: порядок (m. noun, 'order/tidiness'; fleeting -о-: gen. поря́дка). Per-token: В (prep., + prep. for location) | комнате (f. noun, prep.sg. of комната) | наконец-то (adv. + emphatic particle, 'finally') | порядок (m. noun, nom.sg., existential subject). Verb 'to be' is dropped in present-tense existential clauses; word order signals topic-focus.
missions.literal: There's finally order in the room.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: ответ (m. noun, 'answer/response'; gen.sg. ответа). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | долго (adv., 'for a long time') | ждал (impf. past m.sg. of ждать) | твоего (poss. pron., m.gen.sg., agrees with ответа) | ответа (m. noun, gen.sg., object). Ждать governs the genitive for abstract or unspecific objects like ответ.
missions.literal: I waited a long time for your answer.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: тихо (adv./predicative, 'quiet/quietly'; from тихий). Per-token: В (prep., + prep. for location) | библиотеке (f. noun, prep.sg. of библиотека) | всегда (adv., 'always') | очень (adv., 'very') | тихо (predicative, impers. main predicate). Predicative adverbs like тихо form impersonal sentences describing ambient state.
missions.literal: It's always very quiet in the library.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: знакомый (adj./n., 'acquaintance/familiar'; declines like an adjective). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | встретил (perf. past m.sg. of встретить) | знакомого (substantivised adj., m.acc.sg. anim., direct object) | в (prep., + prep. for location) | магазине (m. noun, prep.sg. of магазин). Animate masculines take genitive-form acc. endings, hence знакомого not знакомый.
missions.literal: I met an acquaintance at the store.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: газета (f. noun, 'newspaper'; acc.sg. газету). Per-token: Папа (m. anim. noun (f-declension), nom.sg., subject) | читает (3sg pres. of читать) | газету (f. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | каждое (det., n.acc.sg., agrees with утро) | утро (n. noun, acc.sg., temporal adverbial). Bare accusative of каждое утро/день signals habitual repetition.
missions.literal: Dad reads the newspaper every morning.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: помощь (f. noun, 'help/aid'; soft sign noun, nom./acc. identical). Per-token: Мне (1sg pers. pron., dat.) | срочно (adv., 'urgently') | нужна (short adj. f.sg. of нужный, agrees with помощь) | твоя (poss. pron., f.nom.sg., agrees with помощь) | помощь (f. noun, nom.sg., logical subject). The нужен/нужна/нужно construction agrees with the needed thing; the needer goes in dative.
missions.literal: I urgently need your help.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: сильный (adj., 'strong'; soft variant сильнее in comparative). Per-token: У (prep., + gen. for possession) | него (3sg.m pers. pron., gen.) | очень (adv., 'very') | сильный (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with характер) | характер (m. noun, nom.sg., possessed). Adjectives precede their noun and copy gender, number, and case.
missions.literal: He has a very strong character.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: скорый (adj., 'quick/prompt'; pos. degree). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | надеюсь (1sg pres. of надеяться) | на (prep., + acc. with надеяться, 'to hope for') | скорый (adj., m.acc.sg., agrees with ответ) | ответ (m. noun, acc.sg., object of на). Надеяться на что requires the accusative for the hoped-for outcome.
missions.literal: I'm hoping for a prompt reply.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: собака (f. noun, 'dog'; nom.sg.). Per-token: Соседская (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with собака) | собака (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | громко (adv., 'loudly') | лает (3sg pres. of лаять) | ночью (f. noun, instr.sg. of ночь, time adverbial). Instrumental of times of day (днём, ночью, утром, вечером) functions adverbially.
missions.literal: The neighbour's dog barks loudly at night.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: дерево (n. noun, 'tree'; irregular pl. дере́вья). Per-token: В (prep., + prep. for location) | саду (m. noun, loc.sg. of сад, special -у after в/на) | растёт (3sg pres. of расти) | большое (adj., n.nom.sg., agrees with дерево) | дерево (n. noun, nom.sg., subject). Сад takes the special locative ending -у́ after в and на.
missions.literal: A big tree grows in the garden.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: снег (m. noun, 'snow'; loc. в снегу́). Per-token: Зимой (f. noun, instr.sg. of зима, time adverbial) | здесь (adv., 'here') | идёт (3sg pres. of идти, idiom for precipitation) | сильный (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with снег) | снег (m. noun, nom.sg., subject). Russian uses идти for falling weather: идёт снег/дождь.
missions.literal: In winter, heavy snow falls here.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: сон (m. noun, 'dream/sleep'; fleeting -о-: gen. сна). Per-token: Мне (1sg pers. pron., dat., experiencer) | приснился (perf. past m.sg. of присниться, refl.) | странный (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with сон) | сон (m. noun, nom.sg., grammatical subject) | вчера (adv., 'yesterday'). With присниться the dreamer is in the dative and the dream in the nominative.
missions.literal: I had a strange dream yesterday.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: смысл (m. noun, 'sense/meaning'; gen.sg. смысла). Per-token: В (prep., + prep. for location) | этом (dem. pron., n.prep.sg.) | нет (neg. existential, governs gen.) | никакого (neg. pron., m.gen.sg., agrees with смысла) | смысла (m. noun, gen.sg.). The нет-construction requires the genitive of the absent thing; negative pronouns agree with it.
missions.literal: There's no sense in this at all.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: смочь (perf. verb, 'to be able to'; perf. pair of мочь). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | смогу (1sg fut. perf. of смочь) | прийти (perf. inf. of прийти, complement) | завтра (adv., 'tomorrow') | вечером (n. noun, instr.sg. of вечер, time adverbial). Perfective смочь implies a future capability to perform a single action.
missions.literal: I'll be able to come tomorrow evening.

missions.phrase: Я ничего не имею против тебя.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: против (prep., 'against'; governs gen.). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | ничего (neg. pron., gen., direct object under negation) | не (neg. particle) | имею (1sg pres. of иметь) | против (prep., + gen.) | тебя (2sg pers. pron., gen.). Иметь что против кого — set construction meaning 'to hold something against someone'.
missions.literal: I don't have anything against you.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: бежать (impf. verb, 'to run'; irreg., 2sg бежишь). Per-token: Куда (interrog. adv., 'where to') | ты (2sg pers. pron., nom.) | бежишь (2sg pres. of бежать) | так (adv., 'so') | быстро (adv., 'quickly'). Бежать is the unidirectional motion verb; куда asks about destination.
missions.literal: Where are you running so fast?

missions.phrase: Дети играют во дворе после школы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: двор (m. noun, 'yard/courtyard'; loc. во дворе́). Per-token: Дети (pl. noun, nom.pl. of ребёнок, subject) | играют (3pl pres. of играть) | во (variant of в before consonant clusters, + prep.) | дворе (m. noun, prep.sg. of двор) | после (prep., + gen.) | школы (f. noun, gen.sg. of школа). Во is used before words beginning with в- or ф- + consonant for easier pronunciation.
missions.literal: The children play in the yard after school.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: форма (f. noun, 'shape/form'; nom.sg.). Per-token: У (prep., + gen. for possession) | этого (dem. pron., n.gen.sg., agrees with облака) | облака (n. noun, gen.sg. of облако) | странная (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with форма) | форма (f. noun, nom.sg., possessed). Inanimate possessors also take у + gen., as for living owners.
missions.literal: This cloud has a strange shape.

missions.phrase: Это очень простой и понятный вопрос.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: простой (adj., 'simple'; pos. degree, comp. проще). Per-token: Это (dem. pron., n.nom.sg., subject) | очень (adv., 'very') | простой (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with вопрос) | и (coord. conj., 'and') | понятный (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with вопрос) | вопрос (m. noun, nom.sg., predicate). Adjectives joined by и share the noun and agree with it independently.
missions.literal: This is a very simple and clear question.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: приехать (perf. verb, 'to arrive by vehicle'; impf. приезжать). Per-token: Гости (m. anim. noun, nom.pl. of гость, subject) | приехали (perf. past pl. of приехать) | поздно (adv., 'late') | ночью (f. noun, instr.sg. of ночь, time adverbial). Приехать implies arrival via transport, contrasting with прийти (on foot).
missions.literal: The guests arrived late at night.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: иной (adj./pron., 'other/different'; bookish synonym of другой). Per-token: На (prep., + acc. for target) | это (dem. pron., n.acc.sg.) | есть (3sg pres. of быть, existential) | иной (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with взгляд) | взгляд (m. noun, nom.sg., subject). Иной carries a slightly more formal nuance than другой in modern Russian.
missions.literal: There's a different view on this.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: кричать (impf. verb, 'to shout/yell'; govern на + acc. for target). Per-token: Не (neg. particle) | надо (modal predicative, 'one should') | кричать (impf. inf., complement of надо) | на (prep., + acc. for target of shouting) | ребёнка (m. anim. noun, acc.sg. of ребёнок). Не надо + impf. inf. is the standard way to discourage an action.
missions.literal: You shouldn't shout at the child.

missions.phrase: У меня есть возможность поехать в Париж.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: возможность (f. noun, 'opportunity/possibility'; -ость suffix). Per-token: У (prep., + gen. for possession) | меня (1sg pers. pron., gen.) | есть (3sg pres. of быть, existential) | возможность (f. noun, nom.sg., possessed) | поехать (perf. inf., modifier of возможность) | в (prep., + acc. for destination) | Париж (m. proper noun, acc.sg.). Abstract nouns like возможность readily take an infinitive complement.
missions.literal: I have a chance to go to Paris.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: общество (n. noun, 'society'; nom.sg.). Per-token: Современное (adj., n.nom.sg., agrees with общество) | общество (n. noun, nom.sg., subject) | быстро (adv., 'quickly') | меняется (3sg pres. refl. of меняться). Reflexive -ся here makes the verb intransitive: 'is changing' rather than 'is changing something'.
missions.literal: Modern society is changing quickly.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: зелёный (adj., 'green'; ё is fixed-stressed). Per-token: У (prep., + gen. for possession) | неё (3sg.f pers. pron., gen.) | красивые (adj., m.nom.pl., agrees with глаза) | зелёные (adj., m.nom.pl., agrees with глаза) | глаза (m. noun, nom.pl. of глаз). Multiple adjectives modifying one noun stack without commas when each independently characterises it.
missions.literal: She has beautiful green eyes.

missions.phrase: У меня болит грудь после кашля.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: грудь (f. soft-sign noun, 'chest/breast'; nom.sg.). Per-token: У (prep., + gen. for possession) | меня (1sg pers. pron., gen., experiencer) | болит (3sg pres. of болеть) | грудь (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | после (prep., + gen.) | кашля (m. noun, gen.sg. of кашель). The 'у + gen. + болит' frame expresses bodily pain; the body part is the subject.
missions.literal: My chest hurts after coughing.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: угол (m. noun, 'corner'; fleeting -о-: gen. угла́). Per-token: Поставь (perf. imp. 2sg of поставить) | стул (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | в (prep., + acc. for direction) | угол (m. noun, acc.sg., destination) | комнаты (f. noun, gen.sg. of комната, modifier). В + acc. with motion verbs indicates the destination of placement.
missions.literal: Put the chair in the corner of the room.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: открыть (perf. verb, 'to open'; impf. открывать). Per-token: Можешь (2sg pres. of мочь) | открыть (perf. inf., complement) | окно (n. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | пожалуйста (politeness particle). Можешь + perf. inf. is a standard polite request frame.
missions.literal: Can you open the window, please?

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: происходить (impf. verb, 'to happen/occur'; perf. произойти). Per-token: Что (interrog. pron., nom.sg., subject) | здесь (adv., 'here') | сейчас (adv., 'now') | происходит (3sg pres. of происходить). Что as subject takes neuter singular agreement when the answer is unknown.
missions.literal: What's happening here right now?

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: ладно (particle/interjection, 'okay/all right'; concessive). Per-token: Ладно (discourse particle, acceptance) | я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | согласен (short adj. m.sg. of согласный, predicate) | помочь (perf. inf., complement of согласен) | тебе (2sg pers. pron., dat., recipient of help). Помочь takes the dative for the person helped.
missions.literal: Okay, I agree to help you.

missions.phrase: Он носит чёрный костюм на работу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: черный (adj., 'black'; modern spelling чёрный). Per-token: Он (3sg.m pers. pron., nom.) | носит (3sg pres. of носить, multidirectional 'to wear') | черный (adj., m.acc.sg. inanim., agrees with костюм) | костюм (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | на (prep., + acc. for purpose/destination) | работу (f. noun, acc.sg. of работа). Носить (impf.) signals habitual/regular wearing.
missions.literal: He wears a black suit to work.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: век (m. noun, 'century/age'; loc. ве́ке). Per-token: В (prep., + prep. for time period) | двадцатом (ord. numeral, m.prep.sg., agrees with веке) | веке (m. noun, prep.sg. of век) | многое (subst. adj., n.nom.sg., subject) | изменилось (perf. past n.sg. refl. of измениться). Ordinal numerals decline as adjectives and agree with the noun they modify.
missions.literal: In the twentieth century a lot changed.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: карман (m. noun, 'pocket'; acc.sg. inanim. = карман). Per-token: Положи (perf. imp. 2sg of положить) | телефон (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | в (prep., + acc. for direction) | карман (m. noun, acc.sg., destination) | куртки (f. noun, gen.sg. of куртка, modifier). Genitive noun after another noun expresses possession or part-of relation.
missions.literal: Put the phone in the pocket of the jacket.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: ехать (impf. unidir. verb, 'to go by vehicle'; еду, едешь). missions.phrase: Автор этой книги живёт в Лондоне.

missions.phrase: Я изучаю немецкий язык в университете.

missions.phrase: У неё на лице была добрая улыбка.

Per-token: У (prep., + gen.) | неё (3sg.f pron., gen. with н-prefix) | на (prep., + prep.) | лице (n. noun, prep.sg. of лицо) | была (past f.sg. of быть, agrees with улыбка) | добрая (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with улыбка) | улыбка (f. noun, nom.sg., subject). Past copula agrees with the subject's gender; chained location frames are normal.
missions.literal: She had a kind smile on her face.

missions.phrase: Их борьба за свободу продолжалась годами.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: борьба (f. noun, 'struggle'; gen.sg. борьбы). Per-token: Их (3pl poss. pron., indecl.) | борьба (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | за (prep., + acc., 'for the sake of') | свободу (f. noun, acc.sg. of свобода) | продолжалась (past f.sg. of продолжаться, impf.refl., 'to continue') | годами (m. noun, instr.pl. of год, adverbial 'for years'). Instr.pl. of time expresses extended duration; их is indeclinable.
missions.literal: Their struggle for freedom went on for years.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: ворот (m. noun, 'collar (of shirt)'; not to be confused with ворота pl.tantum 'gate'). Per-token: Ворот (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | рубашки (f. noun, gen.sg. of рубашка) | был (past m.sg. of быть, agrees with ворот) | аккуратно (manner adv.) | застёгнут (short passive past participle, m.sg. of застегнуть, predicate). Past copula + short participle forms a stative passive; gen. of substance after the head noun.
missions.literal: The collar of the shirt was neatly buttoned.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: ящик (m. noun, 'box, drawer, crate'; nom.sg. ящик). Per-token: Положи (imp.2sg of положить, perf., 'put/place') | письма (n. noun, acc.pl. of письмо) | в (prep., + acc. for direction) | этот (dem. pron., m.acc.sg., agrees with ящик) | ящик (m. noun, acc.sg., inanimate = nom. form). Direction-of-motion uses в + accusative; этот agrees with the masculine inanimate noun.
missions.literal: Put the letters into this box.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: этаж (m. noun, 'floor, storey'; nom.sg. этаж, stressed on ending). Per-token: Мы (1pl pers. pron., nom.) | живём (1pl pres. of жить, impf., 'to live') | на (prep., + prep. for static location) | пятом (ord. num., m.prep.sg. of пятый) | этаже (m. noun, prep.sg. of этаж). Floor numbers use на + prepositional case; ordinal agrees in gender, number, case with the noun.
missions.literal: We live on the fifth floor.

missions.phrase: Мой брат будет служить в армии.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: служить (impf. verb, 'to serve'; takes dat. for whom/what one serves, or в + prep. for the institution). Per-token: Мой (poss. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with брат) | брат (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | будет (3sg fut. of быть, auxiliary) | служить (impf. infinitive, forms compound future with будет) | в (prep., + prep. for location) | армии (f. noun, prep.sg. of армия). Compound future = будет + imperfective infinitive; describes an extended ongoing service.
missions.literal: My brother will serve in the army.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: вновь (adv., 'again, anew'; bookish synonym of снова/опять). Per-token: Он (3sg.m pers. pron., nom.) | вновь (adv. of repetition, modifies опоздал) | опоздал (perf. past m.sg. of опоздать, 'to be late') | на (prep., + acc. with destinations like работа, урок) | работу (f. noun, acc.sg. of работа). 'Опоздать на' takes accusative; вновь is slightly formal compared to снова.
missions.literal: He was late for work again.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: голубой (adj., 'light blue, sky-blue'; distinct from синий 'deep blue'). Per-token: У (prep., + gen. for possession) | неё (3sg.f pers. pron., gen. of она, with н- after prep.) | красивые (adj., pl.nom., agrees with глаза) | голубые (adj., pl.nom. of голубой, agrees with глаза) | глаза (m. noun, irregular nom.pl. of глаз). 'У X есть Y' construction omits есть when describing inherent traits like eye colour.
missions.literal: She has beautiful light-blue eyes.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: нечего (neg. pron., 'nothing to'; takes dat. logical subject + infinitive; no nom. form). Per-token: Мне (1sg pers. pron., dat. of я) | сегодня (adv. of time, 'today') | нечего (neg. pron., functions as object of делать) | делать (impf. infinitive, 'to do'). Construction: dat. + нечего + infinitive = 'X has nothing to V'; stress falls on не- (нЕчего).
missions.literal: I have nothing to do today.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: революция (f. noun, 'revolution'; nom.sg., declines like other -ия nouns). Per-token: Революция (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | изменила (perf. past f.sg. of изменить, 'to change') | всю (det., f.acc.sg. of весь, agrees with страну) | страну (f. noun, acc.sg. of страна, direct object). Past-tense verb agrees with subject gender; perfective signals a single completed transformation.
missions.literal: The revolution changed the whole country.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: впервые (adv., 'for the first time'; from в + первый). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | впервые (adv. of frequency/order, modifies увидел) | увидел (perf. past m.sg. of увидеть, 'to catch sight of') | море (n. noun, acc.sg., direct object; inanimate n. = nom.) | летом (instr.sg. of лето, adverbial 'in summer'). Bare instrumental of season expresses 'in [season]' without a preposition.
missions.literal: I saw the sea for the first time in the summer.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: сосед (m. animate noun, 'neighbour'; irregular pl. соседи, gen.pl. соседей). Per-token: Мой (poss. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with сосед) | сосед (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | играет (3sg pres. of играть, impf., 'to play') | на (prep., + prep. for musical instruments) | скрипке (f. noun, prep.sg. of скрипка). Playing instruments uses на + prepositional, contrasting with sports (играть в + acc.).
missions.literal: My neighbour plays the violin.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: сестра (f. animate noun, 'sister'; irregular pl. сёстры, gen.pl. сестёр). Per-token: Моя (poss. pron., f.nom.sg., agrees with сестра) | сестра (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | учится (3sg pres. of учиться, impf., refl., 'to study') | в (prep., + prep. for location) | университете (m. noun, prep.sg. of университет). Учиться is reflexive without an object; the institution takes в + prepositional.
missions.literal: My sister studies at the university.

missions.phrase: Это был долгий и трудный день.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: долгий (adj., 'long [in time]'; for spatial length use длинный). Per-token: Это (dem. pron., n.nom.sg., subject) | был (past m.sg. of быть, agrees with день) | долгий (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with день) | и (coord. conj., 'and') | трудный (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with день) | день (m. noun, nom.sg., predicate nominative). With было/был, the predicate noun stays in nominative; the linking verb agrees with the predicate noun, not это.
missions.literal: It was a long and hard day.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: чей (interrog. poss. pron., 'whose'; agrees in gender/number/case with the possessed). Per-token: Чей (interrog. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with рюкзак) | это (dem. particle, invariant in identification) | рюкзак (m. noun, nom.sg.) | на (prep., + prep. for location) | столе (m. noun, prep.sg. of стол). Чей agrees with the thing owned, not the owner; word order Чей-это-NOUN is standard for identification questions.
missions.literal: Whose backpack is this on the table?

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: поверить (perf. verb, 'to believe'; impf. counterpart верить; takes dat. of person, в + acc. of belief). Per-token: Трудно (predicative adv., 'it is hard') | поверить (perf. infinitive, complement of трудно) | в (prep., + acc. for object of belief) | такую (det., f.acc.sg. of такой, agrees with историю) | историю (f. noun, acc.sg. of история). Impersonal predicatives like трудно, легко take an infinitive without a subject.
missions.literal: It's hard to believe such a story.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: ситуация (f. noun, 'situation'; -ия type, prep.sg. ситуации). Per-token: Ситуация (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | на (prep., + prep. for location) | дороге (f. noun, prep.sg. of дорога) | была (past f.sg. of быть, agrees with subject) | опасной (adj., f.instr.sg. of опасный, predicate). After past tense of быть, predicate adjectives typically take instrumental for temporary or descriptive states.
missions.literal: The situation on the road was dangerous.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: взглянуть (perf. verb, 'to glance, take a look'; takes на + acc.; impf. counterpart взглядывать is rare, usu. paired with смотреть). Per-token: Можно (impersonal pred., 'may, is allowed') | взглянуть (perf. infinitive, complement of можно) | на (prep., + acc. for target of looking) | твою (poss. pron., f.acc.sg. of твой, agrees with книгу) | книгу (f. noun, acc.sg. of книга). Можно + infinitive forms a polite request for permission.
missions.literal: May I take a look at your book?

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: слабый (adj., 'weak'; short form слаб, слаба, слабо, слабы). Per-token: После (prep., + gen.) | болезни (f. noun, gen.sg. of болезнь) | он (3sg.m pers. pron., nom.) | очень (intensifier adv., 'very') | слабый (adj., m.nom.sg., predicate, agrees with он). После always takes genitive; full-form adjective as predicate suggests a more permanent quality than the short form слаб.
missions.literal: After his illness he is very weak.

missions.phrase: Огромное количество людей пришло на концерт.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: количество (n. noun, 'quantity, amount'; governs gen. of the counted). Per-token: Огромное (adj., n.nom.sg., agrees with количество) | количество (n. noun, nom.sg., subject) | людей (m. noun, gen.pl. of люди, governed by количество) | пришло (perf. past n.sg. of прийти, agrees with neuter subject количество) | на (prep., + acc.) | концерт (m. noun, acc.sg., inanim. = nom.). Quantifying noun + gen.pl. takes neuter singular agreement on the verb.
missions.literal: A huge number of people came to the concert.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: вызывать (impf. verb, 'to evoke, call forth, summon'; perf. вызвать; takes acc.). Per-token: Этот (dem. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with фильм) | фильм (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | вызывает (3sg pres. of вызывать, impf.) | сильные (adj., pl.acc., agrees with эмоции) | эмоции (f. noun, acc.pl. of эмоция, direct object). Inanimate plural accusative equals nominative; вызывать + abstract noun is a common collocation ('to provoke/cause [reactions]').
missions.literal: This film evokes strong emotions.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: уверенный (adj./past pass. part. of уверить, 'confident, assured'; uses в + prep.). Per-token: Он (3sg.m pers. pron., nom.) | уверенный (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with человек) | в (prep., + prep.) | себе (refl. pron., prep. of себя) | человек (m. noun, nom.sg., predicate). 'Уверенный в себе' = 'self-confident'; the reflexive себе refers back to он as logical subject.
missions.literal: He is a self-confident person.

missions.phrase: Выход из метро справа от вас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: выход (m. noun, 'exit, way out'; from выходить). Per-token: Выход (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | из (prep., + gen. for 'out of') | метро (n. noun, indeclinable) | справа (adv., 'on the right') | от (prep., + gen.) | вас (2pl pers. pron., gen. of вы). Метро is indeclinable and stays the same in all cases; от + gen. marks the reference point.
missions.literal: The exit from the metro is to your right.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: совет (m. noun, 'advice, council'; here = piece of advice, countable in Russian). Per-token: Дай (imp.2sg of дать, perf., 'give') | мне (1sg pers. pron., dat. of я, indirect object) | один (num., m.acc.sg., agrees with совет) | полезный (adj., m.acc.sg., agrees with совет) | совет (m. noun, acc.sg., inanim. = nom.). Unlike English 'advice' (uncountable), совет is countable: один совет, два совета.
missions.literal: Give me one useful piece of advice.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: дурак (m. animate noun, 'fool'; feminine дура). Per-token: Не (neg. particle) | будь (imp.2sg of быть, 'be') | таким (det., m.instr.sg. of такой, agrees with дураком) | дураком (m. noun, instr.sg., predicate of быть) | пожалуйста (politeness particle). Predicate of быть imperative typically takes instrumental; такой intensifies the noun ('such a fool').
missions.literal: Don't be such a fool, please.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: любимый (adj./past pass. part. of любить, 'beloved, favourite'). Per-token: Это (dem. particle in identification) | моя (poss. pron., f.nom.sg., agrees with песня) | любимая (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with песня) | песня (f. noun, nom.sg., predicate) | детства (n. noun, gen.sg. of детство, of-relation). The genitive детства expresses 'of childhood' without a preposition.
missions.literal: This is my favourite song from childhood.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: союз (m. noun, 'union, alliance, conjunction [gram.]'). Per-token: Между (prep., + instr. for 'between') | ними (3pl pers. pron., instr. of они, with н-) | возник (perf. past m.sg. of возникнуть, 'to arise') | крепкий (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with союз) | союз (m. noun, nom.sg., subject). Между governs instrumental; postposed subject is common when emphasis falls on the new information.
missions.literal: A strong alliance arose between them.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: лето (n. noun, 'summer'; instr. летом is adverbial 'in summer'). Per-token: Прошлое (adj., n.nom.sg. of прошлый, agrees with лето) | лето (n. noun, nom.sg., subject) | было (past n.sg. of быть) | очень (intensifier adv.) | жарким (adj., n.instr.sg. of жаркий, predicate). After past быть, descriptive predicate adjectives take instrumental.
missions.literal: Last summer was very hot.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: ожидать (impf. verb, 'to expect, await'; takes gen. of abstract object, acc. of concrete person). Per-token: Мы (1pl pers. pron., nom.) | будем (1pl fut. of быть, auxiliary) | ожидать (impf. infinitive, compound future) | вашего (poss. pron., m.gen.sg. of ваш, agrees with ответа) | ответа (m. noun, gen.sg. of ответ). Genitive of abstract object reflects partitive/indefinite expectation; common in formal correspondence.
missions.literal: We will await your response.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: пришлый (adj., 'newcomer, alien, not native'; from прийти; colloquial/dialectal flavour). Per-token: В (prep., + prep. for location) | городе (m. noun, prep.sg. of город) | живут (3pl pres. of жить, impf.) | пришлые (adj., pl.nom., agrees with люди) | люди (m. noun, nom.pl. of человек, subject). Adjective precedes the noun and agrees in number and case with the head люди.
missions.literal: Newcomers live in the city.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: висеть (impf. verb of position, 'to hang [be hanging]'; differs from active вешать 'to hang up'). Per-token: Картина (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | висит (3sg pres. of висеть, impf.) | над (prep., + instr. for 'above') | старым (adj., m.instr.sg. of старый, agrees with диваном) | диваном (m. noun, instr.sg. of диван). Над governs instrumental; висеть is stative, parallel to стоять and лежать.
missions.literal: The picture hangs above the old sofa.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: граница (f. noun, 'border, boundary'; за границей = abroad). Per-token: Мы (1pl pers. pron., nom.) | пересекли (perf. past pl. of пересечь, 'to cross') | границу (f. noun, acc.sg. of граница, direct object) | ночью (instr.sg. of ночь, adverbial 'at night'). Bare instrumental of time-of-day (ночью, утром, днём, вечером) means 'during [that time]'.
missions.literal: We crossed the border at night.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: цвет (m. noun, 'colour'; distinct pl. цвета 'colours' vs. цветы 'flowers'). Per-token: Какой (interrog. det., m.nom.sg., agrees with цвет) | твой (poss. pron., m.nom.sg.) | любимый (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with цвет) | цвет (m. noun, nom.sg., predicate). Какой asks for description and agrees with the noun; copula 'is' is omitted in present-tense identification questions.
missions.literal: What's your favourite colour?

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: серьёзный (adj., 'serious'; note the ё). Per-token: У (prep., + gen. for possession) | нас (1pl pers. pron., gen. of мы) | серьёзный (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with разговор) | разговор (m. noun, nom.sg., grammatical subject of possession clause) | впереди (adv., 'ahead, in front'). У + gen. construction omits есть because the focus is the characterisation, not the existence.
missions.literal: We have a serious conversation ahead of us.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: создать (perf. verb, 'to create'; impf. создавать). Per-token: Они (3pl pers. pron., nom.) | хотят (3pl pres. of хотеть, impf., irregular conjugation) | создать (perf. infinitive, complement of хотят) | новую (adj., f.acc.sg. of новый, agrees with компанию) | компанию (f. noun, acc.sg. of компания, direct object). Хотеть + perf. infinitive expresses a desire to complete a single action.
missions.literal: They want to create a new company.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: интересный (adj., 'interesting'; short form интересен, интересна). Per-token: Расскажи (imp.2sg of рассказать, perf., 'to tell, narrate') | мне (1sg pers. pron., dat. of я, indirect object) | интересную (adj., f.acc.sg. of интересный, agrees with историю) | историю (f. noun, acc.sg. of история, direct object). Рассказать takes dat. of recipient + acc. of content.
missions.literal: Tell me an interesting story.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: свобода (f. noun, 'freedom'; на свободе = 'at liberty'). Per-token: Свобода (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | слова (n. noun, gen.sg. of слово, qualifying свобода) | важна (short adj., f.sg. of важный, predicate) | для (prep., + gen.) | общества (n. noun, gen.sg. of общество). 'Свобода слова' is a fixed compound = 'freedom of speech'; short-form adjective is typical of generalising statements.
missions.literal: Freedom of speech is important for society.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: зато (coord. conj., 'but on the other hand, to make up for it'; introduces compensating clause). Per-token: Дорого (predicative adv., 'expensive [it is]') | зато (coord. conj., contrastive-compensatory) | очень (intensifier adv.) | качественно (predicative adv., 'of high quality'). Зато pairs a negative with a positive trade-off; both clauses use impersonal predicative adverbs.
missions.literal: It's expensive, but on the other hand very high-quality.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: стул (m. noun, 'chair'; irregular pl. стулья). Per-token: Поставь (imp.2sg of поставить, perf., 'to place upright') | этот (dem. pron., m.acc.sg., agrees with стул) | стул (m. noun, acc.sg., inanim. = nom., direct object) | возле (prep., + gen.) | окна (n. noun, gen.sg. of окно). Поставить implies vertical placement; возле = 'next to, near'.
missions.literal: Put this chair next to the window.

missions.phrase: Завтра я должен уехать из города.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: уехать (perf. verb, 'to leave [by transport]'; impf. уезжать; from ехать with prefix у- = away from). Per-token: Завтра (adv. of time) | я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | должен (short adj., m.sg. of должный, 'must') | уехать (perf. infinitive, complement of должен) | из (prep., + gen. 'out of') | города (m. noun, gen.sg. of город). Должен + infinitive = obligation; из + gen. for leaving an enclosed place.
missions.literal: Tomorrow I have to leave the city.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: поезд (m. noun, 'train'; nom.pl. поезда, stressed on ending). Per-token: Поезд (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | прибывает (3sg pres. of прибывать, impf., 'to arrive') | на (prep., + acc. for destination) | третий (ord. num., m.acc.sg., agrees with путь) | путь (m. noun, acc.sg., inanim. = nom., 'track, platform'). Train platforms use на + acc. for direction; impf. present can describe scheduled arrivals.
missions.literal: The train arrives at platform three.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: музыка (f. noun, 'music'; usually uncountable). Per-token: Громкая (adj., f.nom.sg. of громкий, agrees with музыка) | музыка (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | мешает (3sg pres. of мешать, impf., 'to disturb, hinder'; takes dat.) | мне (1sg pers. pron., dat. of я) | спать (impf. infinitive, complement of мешает). Мешать governs dative of the person hindered + infinitive of the hindered action.
missions.literal: The loud music keeps me from sleeping.

missions.phrase: Сядь в тень под этим деревом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: тень (f. noun, 'shadow, shade'; declines like soft-stem ж feminines). Per-token: Сядь (imp.2sg of сесть, perf., 'sit down') | в (prep., + acc. for direction) | тень (f. noun, acc.sg. of тень, inanim. = nom. spelling) | под (prep., + instr. for static location 'under') | этим (dem. pron., n.instr.sg. of этот, agrees with деревом) | деревом (n. noun, instr.sg. of дерево). Direction = в + acc.; static location under = под + instr.
missions.literal: Sit down in the shade under this tree.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: лошадь (f. noun, 'horse'; soft-stem feminine, gen.pl. лошадей). Per-token: Белая (adj., f.nom.sg. of белый, agrees with лошадь) | лошадь (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | паслась (impf. past f.sg. of пастись, refl., 'to graze') | на (prep., + prep. for location) | лугу (m. noun, irregular prep.sg. of луг, 'meadow'). Луг takes the locative ending -у after на/в, like лес → в лесу.
missions.literal: A white horse was grazing in the meadow.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: поле (n. noun, 'field'; nom.pl. поля). Per-token: Дети (m. noun, nom.pl. of ребёнок, subject) | играли (impf. past pl. of играть) | в (prep., + prep. for location) | широком (adj., n.prep.sg. of широкий, agrees with поле) | поле (n. noun, prep.sg., same form as nom.). Neuter nouns in -е keep the same -е form in prepositional singular.
missions.literal: The children were playing in a wide field.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: выглядеть (impf. verb, 'to look, appear'; takes adverb or instrumental adjective). Per-token: Сегодня (adv. of time) | ты (2sg pers. pron., nom.) | выглядишь (2sg pres. of выглядеть, impf.) | очень (intensifier adv.) | устало (adv. from устал, 'tiredly') | (final adverb). Выглядеть pairs with an adverb of manner (выглядеть хорошо/плохо/устало).
missions.literal: Today you look very tired.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: учиться (impf. verb, refl., 'to study, learn'; takes dat. of subject taught or infinitive). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | учусь (1sg pres. of учиться, refl.) | играть (impf. infinitive, complement) | на (prep., + prep. for instruments) | гитаре (f. noun, prep.sg. of гитара). Учиться + infinitive = 'to learn to do'; the -сь reflexive is obligatory.
missions.literal: I'm learning to play the guitar.

missions.literal: His parents didn't allow him to stay home.

missions.phrase: Я хочу встретить тебя на вокзале.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: встретить (perf. verb, 'to meet, encounter'; impf. встречать). missions.literal: I want to meet you at the station.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: радость (f. noun, 'joy'; soft-stem feminine, instr.sg. радостью). Per-token: С (prep., + instr. 'with') | большой (adj., f.instr.sg. of большой, agrees with радостью) | радостью (f. noun, instr.sg.) | принимаю (1sg pres. of принимать, impf., 'to accept') | приглашение (n. noun, acc.sg., inanim. = nom., direct object). missions.literal: I accept the invitation with great joy.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: острый (adj., 'sharp, spicy, acute'). missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: возраст (m. noun, 'age'; в + prep. for 'at [age]'). Per-token: В (prep., + prep.) | каком (interrog. det., m.prep.sg. of какой, agrees with возрасте) | возрасте (m. noun, prep.sg. of возраст) | ты (2sg pers. pron., nom.) | пошёл (perf. past m.sg. of пойти, 'set off') | в (prep., + acc. for direction) | школу (f. noun, acc.sg. of школа). missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: орган (m. noun, 'organ [of body / institution]'; stress on first syllable; orгАн = musical organ). missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: карта (f. noun, 'map; playing card'). missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: король (m. animate noun, 'king'; soft-stem). missions.phrase: У меня часто возникают новые вопросы.

Per-token: У (prep., + gen. for the experiencer) | меня (1sg pers. pron., gen. of я) | часто (adv. of frequency) | возникают (3pl pres. of возникать, impf., agrees with вопросы) | новые (adj., pl.nom., agrees with вопросы) | вопросы (m. noun, nom.pl. of вопрос, subject).
