missions.phrase: Он сказал, мол, всё уже готово.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: мол (reportative particle, 'allegedly, supposedly'; signals quoted speech). Per-token: Он (3sg.m pers. pron., nom.) | сказал (perf. past m.sg. of сказать) | мол (reportative particle, set off by commas) | всё (det./pron., n.nom.sg., subject of готово) | уже (adv. of time, 'already') | готово (short adj., n.sg. of готовый, predicate). Мол introduces a paraphrased report; the embedded clause uses neuter всё with neuter short adj. готово.
missions.literal: He said, supposedly, that everything is already ready.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: повторить (perf. verb, 'to repeat'; impf. повторять). Per-token: Учитель (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | попросил (perf. past m.sg. of попросить, 'to ask, request') | повторить (perf. infinitive, complement) | трудное (adj., n.acc.sg., agrees with правило) | правило (n. noun, acc.sg., inanim. = nom., direct object). Попросить + infinitive expresses indirect request; perf. infinitive specifies a single repetition.
missions.literal: The teacher asked to repeat the difficult rule.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: название (n. noun, 'name [of thing, place], title'; for people use имя). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | забыл (perf. past m.sg. of забыть, 'to forget') | название (n. noun, acc.sg., inanim. = nom., direct object) | этой (dem. pron., f.gen.sg. of этот, agrees with улицы) | улицы (f. noun, gen.sg. of улица, possessor). Genitive of possessor follows the possessed noun: 'name of this street'.
missions.literal: I forgot the name of this street.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: средний (adj., 'average, middle'; soft-stem adj., m.nom.sg. ending in -ий). Per-token: Это (dem. particle in identification) | средний (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with результат) | результат (m. noun, nom.sg., predicate) | для (prep., + gen.) | класса (m. noun, gen.sg. of класс). 'Средний' is a soft-stem adjective with regular soft endings (среднего, среднему, средним...).
missions.literal: This is an average result for the class.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: пример (m. noun, 'example'; idiom 'привести пример' = 'to give an example'). Per-token: Приведи (imp.2sg of привести, perf., 'to bring, cite') | мне (1sg pers. pron., dat. of я, indirect object) | пример (m. noun, acc.sg., inanim. = nom., direct object) | из (prep., + gen. 'from') | жизни (f. noun, gen.sg. of жизнь). 'Привести пример' is a fixed collocation rather than literal bringing.
missions.literal: Give me an example from life.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: невозможно (predicative adv., 'impossible'; takes infinitive). Per-token: Без (prep., + gen. 'without') | воды (f. noun, gen.sg. of вода) | жить (impf. infinitive, complement of невозможно) | невозможно (predicative adv., main predicate). Impersonal predicative invariant; subject of the action (here generic) is unexpressed.
missions.literal: It's impossible to live without water.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: зеркало (n. noun, 'mirror'; nom.pl. зеркала). Per-token: Посмотри (imp.2sg of посмотреть, perf., 'to look') | на (prep., + acc. for target of looking) | себя (refl. pron., acc.) | в (prep., + acc. for direction) | зеркало (n. noun, acc.sg., inanim. = nom.). 'Смотреть в зеркало' uses в + acc. (looking into); себя refers back to the addressee of the imperative.
missions.literal: Look at yourself in the mirror.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: погибнуть (perf. verb, 'to perish, be killed'; impf. погибать; used for violent/untimely death). Per-token: Многие (det., pl.nom. of многий, agrees with солдаты) | солдаты (m. noun, nom.pl. of солдат, subject) | погибли (perf. past pl. of погибнуть) | на (prep., + prep. for location) | войне (f. noun, prep.sg. of война). Past tense of -нуть verbs drops -ну- in plural and feminine/neuter: погиб, погибла, погибли.
missions.literal: Many soldiers perished in the war.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: американский (relational adj., 'American'; from Америка; relational adjs. have no short form). Per-token: Мы (1pl pers. pron., nom.) | смотрели (impf. past pl. of смотреть, 'to watch') | американский (adj., m.acc.sg., agrees with фильм) | фильм (m. noun, acc.sg., inanim. = nom., direct object) | вчера (adv. of time). Impf. past signals an ongoing/durative viewing; lower-case for nationality adjectives in Russian.
missions.literal: We watched an American film yesterday.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: дым (m. noun, 'smoke'; partitive gen.sg. дыму). Per-token: Из (prep., + gen. 'out of') | трубы (f. noun, gen.sg. of труба, 'pipe, chimney') | поднимался (impf. past m.sg. of подниматься, refl., 'to rise') | густой (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with дым) | дым (m. noun, nom.sg., subject). Subject often follows the verb when introducing new information; reflexive подниматься = intransitive rising.
missions.literal: Thick smoke was rising from the chimney.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: гореть (impf. verb, 'to burn [intrans.]'; perf. сгореть). Per-token: В (prep., + prep. for location) | камине (m. noun, prep.sg. of камин) | ярко (adv. of manner, 'brightly') | горел (impf. past m.sg. of гореть) | огонь (m. noun, nom.sg., subject). Гореть is intransitive (something is on fire) vs. transitive жечь 'to burn sth'; subject often follows the verb in scene-setting sentences.
missions.literal: A fire burned brightly in the fireplace.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: плакать (impf. verb, 'to cry, weep'; perf. заплакать = 'to start crying'). Per-token: Ребёнок (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | начал (perf. past m.sg. of начать, 'to begin') | громко (adv. of manner, 'loudly') | плакать (impf. infinitive, complement of начал). Phase verbs начать/начинать always take an imperfective infinitive.
missions.literal: The child started to cry loudly.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: весьма (adv., bookish intensifier 'quite/very', synonym of очень but more formal). Per-token: Его (3sg.m poss. pron., m.nom.sg.) | доклад (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | был (past m.sg. of быть, link verb) | весьма (adv., modifies интересным) | интересным (adj., m.instr.sg., predicate after был). Predicate adjectives after past forms of быть take the instrumental case.
missions.literal: His report was quite interesting.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: факт (m. noun, 'fact'; nom./acc.sg. share the form). Per-token: Это (demonstr. particle 'this is', invariant in such copular phrases) | известный (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with факт) | исторический (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with факт) | факт (m. noun, nom.sg., predicate nominative). Russian copular 'это + nominative' constructions omit the verb 'to be' in the present tense.
missions.literal: This is a well-known historical fact.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: двигаться (impf. refl. verb, 'to move/be in motion'; perf. counterpart двинуться). Per-token: Машина (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | начала (perf. past f.sg. of начать, 'began') | медленно (adv., manner) | двигаться (impf. infinitive, complement of начала) | вперёд (adv., direction). Phasal verbs like начать/начинать govern an imperfective infinitive.
missions.literal: The car slowly began to move forward.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: рыба (f. noun, 'fish'; nom.sg.). Per-token: На (prep., + acc. 'for' in purpose sense) | ужин (m. noun, acc.sg., purpose of meal) | была (past f.sg. of быть, agrees with рыба) | жареная (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with рыба) | рыба (f. noun, nom.sg., subject). The verb былa agrees in gender with the postposed subject рыба.
missions.literal: For dinner there was fried fish.

missions.phrase: Хочу добавить немного соли в суп.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: добавить (perf. verb, 'to add'; impf. добавлять). Per-token: Хочу (1sg.pres. of хотеть, 'I want') | добавить (perf. infinitive, complement of хочу) | немного (quantifier adv., 'a little', + gen.) | соли (f. noun, gen.sg. of соль, partitive after немного) | в (prep., + acc. for direction) | суп (m. noun, acc.sg., goal). Quantifier adverbs like немного/много require the genitive of the substance.
missions.literal: I want to add a little salt to the soup.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: удивиться (perf. refl. verb, 'to be surprised'; impf. удивляться; governs dat.). Per-token: Ты (2sg pers. pron., nom.) | можешь (2sg.pres. of мочь, 'can') | удивиться (perf. infinitive, complement of можешь) | его (3sg.m poss. pron., m.dat.sg., agrees with ответу) | ответу (m. noun, dat.sg. of ответ, governed by удивиться). The verb удивиться takes a dative object naming the cause of surprise.
missions.literal: You may be surprised at his answer.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: бабушка (f. noun, 'grandmother'; nom.sg.). Per-token: Моя (poss. pron., f.nom.sg., agrees with бабушка) | бабушка (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | живёт (3sg.pres. of жить, 'lives') | в (prep., + prep. for location) | деревне (f. noun, prep.sg. of деревня). The preposition в with the prepositional case marks static location.
missions.literal: My grandmother lives in the village.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: вино (n. noun, 'wine'; nom.sg.). Per-token: Красное (adj., n.nom.sg., agrees with вино) | вино (n. noun, nom.sg., subject) | стоит (3sg.pres. of стоять, 'stands/is') | на (prep., + prep. for surface location) | столе (m. noun, prep.sg. of стол). Russian uses стоять/лежать/висеть to specify the position of inanimate objects where English just uses 'to be'.
missions.literal: The red wine is on the table.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: ибо (subord. conj., archaic/literary 'because, for'; introduces a cause clause). Per-token: Молчу (1sg.pres. of молчать, 'I keep silent') | ибо (subord. conj., 'because') | нечего (neg. pron., gen./acc., 'nothing to') | сказать (perf. infinitive of сказать, 'to say'). The negative pronoun нечего + infinitive is an impersonal construction meaning 'there is nothing to do (X)'.
missions.literal: I keep silent, for there is nothing to say.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: учитель (m. noun, 'teacher'; nom.sg., animate). Per-token: Наш (poss. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with учитель) | учитель (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | объясняет (3sg.pres. of объяснять, impf., 'explains') | новую (adj., f.acc.sg., agrees with тему) | тему (f. noun, acc.sg. of тема, direct object). The imperfective present here conveys an ongoing or habitual action.
missions.literal: Our teacher is explaining a new topic.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: действовать (impf. verb, 'to act/operate'; perf. подействовать in some senses). Per-token: Надо (impersonal predicative, 'it is necessary', + infinitive) | действовать (impf. infinitive, complement of надо) | быстро (adv., manner) | и (coord. conj., 'and') | решительно (adv., manner). Impersonal надо + infinitive expresses obligation without a grammatical subject.
missions.literal: We must act quickly and decisively.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: осторожно (adv., 'carefully'; from adj. осторожный). Per-token: Открывай (2sg.imperative of открывать, impf., 'open') | дверь (f. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | очень (adv., intensifier) | осторожно (adv., manner, modifies открывай). Imperfective imperatives like открывай suit ongoing or general instructions; perf. открой would suit a single request.
missions.literal: Open the door very carefully.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: круг (m. noun, 'circle'; nom./acc.sg. share the form for inanimates). Per-token: Дети (pl. noun, nom.pl., subject; suppletive plural of ребёнок) | встали (perf. past pl. of встать, 'stood up/got into') | в (prep., + acc. for motion into) | широкий (adj., m.acc.sg.inan., agrees with круг) | круг (m. noun, acc.sg., goal of motion). Prep. в + accusative marks motion into a space, not a static location.
missions.literal: The children stood in a wide circle.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: папа (m. noun by meaning, 'dad'; declines like a f. noun ending in -а). Per-token: Мой (poss. pron., m.nom.sg., follows natural gender) | папа (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | работает (3sg.pres. of работать, 'works') | на (prep., + prep. for workplace location) | заводе (m. noun, prep.sg. of завод). Words like папа, дядя, мужчина take masculine agreement despite the -а ending.
missions.literal: My dad works at a factory.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: правильно (adv./predicative, 'correctly/right'; from adj. правильный). Per-token: Ты (2sg pers. pron., nom.) | ответил (perf. past m.sg. of ответить, 'answered') | на (prep., + acc. with ответить) | вопрос (m. noun, acc.sg., governed by на) | правильно (adv., modifies ответил). The verb ответить idiomatically governs 'на + accusative' for what one answers.
missions.literal: You answered the question correctly.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: недавно (adv., 'recently/not long ago'). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | недавно (adv., time) | вернулся (perf. past m.sg.refl. of вернуться, 'returned') | из (prep., + gen., 'from/out of') | отпуска (m. noun, gen.sg. of отпуск, 'vacation'). The reflexive perfective вернуться describes a single completed return.
missions.literal: I recently came back from vacation.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: держаться (impf. refl. verb, 'to hold on'; governs 'за + acc.'). Per-token: Держись (2sg.imperative of держаться) | крепче (comparative adv. of крепко, 'tighter') | за (prep., + acc. for grip/grasp) | поручень (m. noun, acc.sg., object of за). The construction держаться за + accusative is the standard way to express physically holding onto something.
missions.literal: Hold on tighter to the handrail!

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: причем (conj./adv., 'and what's more, moreover'; adds a notable circumstance). Per-token: Он (3sg.m pers. pron., nom.) | опоздал (perf. past m.sg. of опоздать, 'was late') | причем (conj., adds extra circumstance) | без (prep., + gen., 'without') | извинений (n. noun, gen.pl. of извинение). Причем introduces an added, often surprising, circumstance to the main clause.
missions.literal: He was late, and what's more, without an apology.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: лететь (impf. unidirectional motion verb, 'to fly'; multidirectional counterpart летать). Per-token: Самолёт (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | будет (3sg.fut. of быть, auxiliary) | лететь (impf. infinitive forming compound future) | восемь (numeral, nom., governs gen.pl.) | часов (m. noun, gen.pl. of час). Compound future = будет + imperfective infinitive; perfectives never use this construction.
missions.literal: The plane will be flying for eight hours.

missions.phrase: Зимой мы должны носить тёплую одежду.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: носить (impf. multidirectional verb, 'to wear/carry habitually'; unidirectional нести). Per-token: Зимой (f. noun, instr.sg. of зима, time expression 'in winter') | мы (1pl pers. pron., nom.) | должны (short adj. pl., 'must') | носить (impf. infinitive) | тёплую (adj., f.acc.sg., agrees with одежду) | одежду (f. noun, acc.sg. of одежда, direct object). The instrumental of seasons (зимой, летом) expresses 'in/during that season'.
missions.literal: In winter we have to wear warm clothes.

missions.phrase: У нас есть повод для радости.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: повод (m. noun, 'reason/occasion'; takes 'для + gen.' or 'к + dat.'). Per-token: У (prep., + gen. in possession construction) | нас (1pl pers. pron., gen.) | есть (3sg.pres. of быть, 'there is') | повод (m. noun, nom.sg., subject of possession) | для (prep., + gen. 'for') | радости (f. noun, gen.sg. of радость). The possessive У + gen. + есть + nom. is the standard Russian 'to have' construction.
missions.literal: We have a reason for joy.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: лагерь (m. noun, 'camp'; nom./acc.sg. share form). Per-token: Летом (n. noun, instr.sg. of лето, 'in summer') | дети (pl. noun, nom.pl., subject) | поедут (3pl.fut. of поехать, perf., 'will go/set off') | в (prep., + acc. for destination) | лагерь (m. noun, acc.sg., destination). Perfective поехать describes the single act of setting off; for ongoing 'going' Russian uses ехать.
missions.literal: In summer the children will go to camp.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: птица (f. noun, 'bird'; nom.sg.). Per-token: Маленькая (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with птица) | птица (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | сидела (impf. past f.sg. of сидеть, 'was sitting') | на (prep., + prep. for location) | ветке (f. noun, prep.sg. of ветка). The imperfective past сидела describes an ongoing state, not a completed action.
missions.literal: A small bird was sitting on a branch.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: корабль (m. noun, 'ship'; soft-stem, nom.sg.). Per-token: Огромный (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with корабль) | корабль (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | вошёл (perf. past m.sg. of войти, 'entered') | в (prep., + acc. for motion in) | порт (m. noun, acc.sg., destination). The prefix во- + йти signals entering; the perfective marks completion of the entry.
missions.literal: A huge ship entered the port.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: мнение (n. noun, 'opinion'; nom./acc.sg. share form). Per-token: Меня (1sg pers. pron., acc.) | интересует (3sg.pres. of интересовать, 'interests', + acc. of person) | ваше (poss. pron., n.nom.sg., agrees with мнение) | мнение (n. noun, nom.sg., subject). The verb интересовать takes the experiencer in the accusative and the topic in the nominative as subject.
missions.literal: I'm interested in your opinion.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: ночной (adj., 'nighttime, nocturnal'; soft-stem). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | люблю (1sg.pres. of любить, 'love') | ночной (adj., m.acc.sg.inan., agrees with город) | город (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | летом (n. noun, instr.sg. of лето, 'in summer'). For inanimate masculine nouns, accusative singular is identical to the nominative.
missions.literal: I love the city at night in summer.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: здоровый (adj., 'healthy'; also colloq. 'huge/strapping'). Per-token: Мой (poss. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with брат) | брат (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | очень (adv., intensifier) | здоровый (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with человек) | человек (m. noun, nom.sg., predicate nominative). In present-tense copular sentences the predicate noun stays in the nominative.
missions.literal: My brother is a very healthy person.

missions.phrase: В этом году зима была холодная.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: зима (f. noun, 'winter'; nom.sg.). Per-token: В (prep., + prep. for time period) | этом (demonstr. pron., m.prep.sg., agrees with году) | году (m. noun, prep.sg. of год, with special locative ending -у) | зима (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | была (past f.sg. of быть) | холодная (adj., f.nom.sg., predicate). Some masculine nouns (год, лес, сад) take a special locative ending -у after в/на.
missions.literal: This year the winter was cold.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: сухой (adj., 'dry'; hard-stem with stressed endings). Per-token: Сегодня (adv., 'today') | воздух (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | очень (adv., intensifier) | сухой (adj., m.nom.sg., predicate adjective). Present-tense быть is omitted, leaving the predicate adjective in the nominative.
missions.literal: Today the air is very dry.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: километр (m. noun, 'kilometer'; nom.sg. after numeral one). Per-token: До (prep., + gen., 'up to/until') | станции (f. noun, gen.sg. of станция) | остался (perf. past m.sg. of остаться, 'remained') | один (numeral, m.nom.sg., agrees with километр) | километр (m. noun, nom.sg., subject). The numeral один agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies.
missions.literal: One kilometer remained to the station.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: кровать (f. noun, 'bed'; soft-stem ending in -ь, gen.sg. кровати). Per-token: В (prep., + prep. for location) | спальне (f. noun, prep.sg. of спальня) | стоит (3sg.pres. of стоять, 'stands') | новая (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with кровать) | кровать (f. noun, nom.sg., subject). Many Russian feminine nouns end in soft -ь; кровать is one of them, hence the f. agreement.
missions.literal: There is a new bed in the bedroom.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: привыкнуть (perf. verb, 'to get used to'; impf. привыкать; governs 'к + dat.'). Per-token: Трудно (impersonal predicative, 'it's hard', + infinitive) | привыкнуть (perf. infinitive, complement of трудно) | к (prep., + dat., 'to/toward') | новой (adj., f.dat.sg., agrees with работе) | работе (f. noun, dat.sg. of работа, governed by к). Verbs of adjustment like привыкнуть, относиться take their object via 'к + dative'.
missions.literal: It's hard to get used to a new job.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: прочее (subst. adj., n. 'the rest, etc.'; used as a noun in lists). Per-token: Купи (2sg.imperative of купить, perf., 'buy') | хлеб (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | молоко (n. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | и (coord. conj., 'and') | прочее (subst. adj., n.acc.sg., 'other things'). The substantivized neuter form прочее is the basis for the common abbreviation 'и т. п.' / 'и прочее'.
missions.literal: Buy bread, milk, and the rest.

missions.phrase: У тебя есть свободный вечер завтра?
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: свободный (adj., 'free, vacant, unoccupied'). Per-token: У (prep., + gen. in possession) | тебя (2sg pers. pron., gen.) | есть (3sg.pres. of быть, 'is there') | свободный (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with вечер) | вечер (m. noun, nom.sg., subject of possession) | завтра (adv., time). Yes/no questions in Russian rely on intonation, not word order.
missions.literal: Do you have a free evening tomorrow?

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: лестница (f. noun, 'staircase, ladder'; nom.sg.). Per-token: Эта (demonstr. pron., f.nom.sg., agrees with лестница) | лестница (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | ведёт (3sg.pres. of вести, impf., 'leads') | на (prep., + acc. for destination on a surface) | крышу (f. noun, acc.sg. of крыша). Vести here has the metaphorical sense 'to lead (to)', common for roads and stairs.
missions.literal: This staircase leads to the roof.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: неужели (interrog. particle, expresses surprise/disbelief, 'really? can it be that?'). Per-token: Неужели (particle, sentence-initial) | ты (2sg pers. pron., nom.) | ничего (neg. pron., gen., 'nothing') | не (negation particle, required with negative pronouns) | понял (perf. past m.sg. of понять, 'understood'). Russian uses double negation: negative pronouns like ничего must be reinforced by не on the verb.
missions.literal: Did you really not understand anything?

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: обязательно (adv., 'definitely, without fail'). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | обязательно (adv., modal-emphatic) | позвоню (1sg.fut. of позвонить, perf., 'will call') | тебе (2sg pers. pron., dat.; позвонить governs dat.) | вечером (m. noun, instr.sg. of вечер, 'in the evening'). The verb позвонить takes a dative object for the person called, not accusative.
missions.literal: I'll definitely call you in the evening.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: вверх (adv. of direction, 'upward'; static equivalent наверху). Per-token: Подними (2sg.imperative of поднять, perf., 'raise') | руки (f. noun, acc.pl. of рука, direct object) | вверх (directional adv.) | пожалуйста (politeness particle). Russian distinguishes directional вверх ('upward, motion') from locational наверху ('up there, static').
missions.literal: Raise your hands up, please!

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: детство (n. noun, 'childhood'; nom./acc.sg. share form). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | часто (adv., frequency) | вспоминаю (1sg.pres. of вспоминать, impf., 'recall') | своё (reflex. poss. pron., n.acc.sg., agrees with детство) | детство (n. noun, acc.sg., direct object). The reflexive possessive свой is used when the possessor is the subject of the clause.
missions.literal: I often remember my childhood.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: остров (m. noun, 'island'; nom./acc.sg. share form for inanimate). Per-token: Мы (1pl pers. pron., nom.) | поплыли (perf. past pl. of поплыть, 'set off swimming/sailing') | на (prep., + acc. for direction onto/to islands) | маленький (adj., m.acc.sg.inan., agrees with остров) | остров (m. noun, acc.sg., destination). Islands idiomatically take 'на' both for motion (+ acc.) and location (+ prep.).
missions.literal: We set off for a small island.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: статья (f. noun, 'article'; nom.sg., gen.pl. статей). Per-token: Эта (demonstr. pron., f.nom.sg., agrees with статья) | статья (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | очень (adv., intensifier) | интересная (adj., f.nom.sg., predicate adjective). With present-tense быть omitted, the predicate adjective stays in the nominative agreeing with the subject.
missions.literal: This article is very interesting.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: позвонить (perf. verb, 'to call (on the phone)'; impf. звонить; governs dat.). Per-token: Не (negation particle) | забудь (2sg.imperative of забыть, perf., 'forget') | позвонить (perf. infinitive, complement of забудь) | маме (f. noun, dat.sg. of мама, governed by позвонить) | сегодня (adv., time). The pattern не забудь + perf. infinitive is the standard 'don't forget to (do)'.
missions.literal: Don't forget to call mom today.

missions.phrase: Я не ожидал столь тёплого приёма.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: столь (adv., bookish/formal 'so, to such a degree'; colloq. equivalent так, такого). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | не (negation particle) | ожидал (impf. past m.sg. of ожидать, 'was expecting'; governs gen.) | столь (intensifying adv., modifies тёплого) | тёплого (adj., m.gen.sg., agrees with приёма) | приёма (m. noun, gen.sg. of приём, governed by ожидал). Verbs of expectation/wishing such as ожидать typically take the genitive.
missions.literal: I didn't expect such a warm welcome.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: мешать (impf. verb, 'to hinder/disturb'; perf. помешать; governs dat. + infinitive). Per-token: Пожалуйста (politeness particle) | не (negation particle) | мешай (2sg.imperative of мешать) | мне (1sg pers. pron., dat., experiencer) | работать (impf. infinitive of работать, complement). Negated imperatives are usually imperfective in Russian; perf. (не помешай) sounds like a warning, not a request.
missions.literal: Please don't disturb me while I work.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: водка (f. noun, 'vodka'; nom.sg., gen.sg. водки after measure nouns). Per-token: На (prep., + prep. for surface location) | столе (m. noun, prep.sg. of стол) | стояла (impf. past f.sg. of стоять, 'stood') | бутылка (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | водки (f. noun, gen.sg. of водка, partitive after бутылка). Container/quantity nouns govern the genitive of the substance: бутылка вина, чашка чая.
missions.literal: On the table stood a bottle of vodka.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: темнота (f. noun, 'darkness'; nom.sg.). Per-token: В (prep., + prep. for location) | комнате (f. noun, prep.sg. of комната) | стояла (impf. past f.sg. of стоять, idiomatic 'reigned/was') | полная (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with темнота) | темнота (f. noun, nom.sg., subject). Russian often uses стоять idiomatically for atmospheric states: stood silence, darkness, heat.
missions.literal: In the room there was complete darkness.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: возникнуть (perf. verb, 'to arise/come up'; impf. возникать). Per-token: Может (3sg.pres. of мочь, here impersonal-ish 'may') | возникнуть (perf. infinitive, complement of может) | серьёзная (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with проблема) | проблема (f. noun, nom.sg., subject). Возникнуть is unaccusative: its sole argument is the thing arising, which appears in the nominative.
missions.literal: A serious problem may arise.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: способный (adj., 'capable, talented'; short form способен). Per-token: Он (3sg.m pers. pron., nom.) | очень (adv., intensifier) | способный (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with инженер) | молодой (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with инженер) | инженер (m. noun, nom.sg., predicate nominative). Multiple attributive adjectives all agree with the noun in gender, number, and case.
missions.literal: He is a very capable young engineer.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: станция (f. noun, 'station'; nom.sg.). Per-token: Следующая (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with станция) | станция (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | — (dash, replaces omitted быть) | Площадь (f. noun, nom.sg., predicate nominative) | Революции (f. noun, gen.sg. of революция, attributive genitive). The dash (тире) is used in writing where быть would be 'is' between two nominative nouns.
missions.literal: The next station is Revolution Square.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: желать (impf. verb, 'to wish'; governs dat. of person + gen. of thing wished). Per-token: Желаю (1sg.pres. of желать) | вам (2pl/polite pers. pron., dat., recipient) | счастья (n. noun, gen.sg. of счастье, thing wished) | и (coord. conj., 'and') | здоровья (n. noun, gen.sg. of здоровье). Toasts and good-wishes follow the pattern желать кому + gen. (someone + thing).
missions.literal: I wish you happiness and health!

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: попробовать (perf. verb, 'to try/taste/attempt'; impf. пробовать). Per-token: Хочу (1sg.pres. of хотеть, 'I want') | попробовать (perf. infinitive, complement of хочу) | этот (demonstr. pron., m.acc.sg.inan., agrees with рецепт) | новый (adj., m.acc.sg.inan., agrees with рецепт) | рецепт (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object). Modal-like verbs хотеть, мочь, любить freely take both perfective and imperfective infinitives.
missions.literal: I want to try this new recipe.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: получаться (impf. refl. verb, 'to turn out, work out'; perf. получиться; impersonal construction). Per-token: У (prep., + gen. in 'у + кого получается' construction) | меня (1sg pers. pron., gen.) | хорошо (adv., manner) | получается (3sg.pres. of получаться, impersonal) | рисовать (impf. infinitive of рисовать, subject of получаться). The pattern 'у + gen. + получается + infinitive' means 'X is good at / succeeds in doing'.
missions.literal: I'm good at drawing.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: гражданин (m. noun, 'citizen'; irregular pl. граждане). Per-token: Каждый (pron./adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with гражданин) | гражданин (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | обязан (short adj., m.sg., 'is obliged', + infinitive) | соблюдать (impf. infinitive of соблюдать, 'to observe') | закон (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object). Short-form predicate adjectives like обязан, должен take infinitive complements.
missions.literal: Every citizen is obliged to obey the law.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: странно (predicative/adv., 'it's strange'; from adj. странный). Per-token: Странно (impersonal predicative, 'it is strange') | что (subord. conj., 'that') | он (3sg.m pers. pron., nom.) | не (negation particle) | пришёл (perf. past m.sg. of прийти, 'came/arrived'). Impersonal predicatives in -о (странно, ясно, понятно) head subjectless clauses and often take a что-clause.
missions.literal: It's strange that he didn't come.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: вскоре (adv., 'soon, shortly after'; bookish). Per-token: Вскоре (adv., time) | после (prep., + gen., 'after') | этого (demonstr. pron., n.gen.sg.) | начался (perf. past m.sg.refl. of начаться, 'began') | дождь (m. noun, nom.sg., subject). The reflexive начаться (intransitive 'to begin') contrasts with transitive начать ('to start something').
missions.literal: Soon after that, the rain began.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: команда (f. noun, 'team, command'; nom.sg.). Per-token: Наша (poss. pron., f.nom.sg., agrees with команда) | команда (f. noun, nom.sg., subject) | выиграла (perf. past f.sg. of выиграть, 'won') | важный (adj., m.acc.sg.inan., agrees with матч) | матч (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object). The verb выиграть takes the prize/contest in the accusative (выиграть приз, матч).
missions.literal: Our team won an important match.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: заболевание (n. noun, 'disease/illness'; nom./acc.sg. share form). Per-token: Врач (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | определил (perf. past m.sg. of определить, 'identified, diagnosed') | редкое (adj., n.acc.sg., agrees with заболевание) | заболевание (n. noun, acc.sg., direct object). Neuter nouns in -ие/-ание have identical nominative and accusative forms.
missions.literal: The doctor diagnosed a rare illness.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: живот (m. noun, 'belly, stomach'; nom.sg.). Per-token: У (prep., + gen. in experiencer construction) | ребёнка (m. noun, gen.sg. of ребёнок) | болит (3sg.pres. of болеть, 'hurts') | живот (m. noun, nom.sg., subject of болит). The 'у + gen. + болит + nom. body-part' pattern is the standard way to say 'X's Y hurts'.
missions.literal: The child has a stomachache.

missions.phrase: Не ставь чашку на край стола.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: ставить (impf. verb, 'to put/place upright'; perf. поставить). Per-token: Не (negation particle) | ставь (2sg.imperative of ставить) | чашку (f. noun, acc.sg. of чашка, direct object) | на (prep., + acc. for surface destination) | край (m. noun, acc.sg., destination) | стола (m. noun, gen.sg. of стол, attributive genitive). Ставить (upright) contrasts with класть (laying flat); choice depends on the object's orientation.
missions.literal: Don't put the cup on the edge of the table.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: ради (prep., 'for the sake of'; governs gen.; can be pre- or postposed). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | сделаю (1sg.fut. of сделать, perf., 'will do') | это (demonstr. pron., n.acc.sg., direct object) | ради (prep., + gen.) | тебя (2sg pers. pron., gen.). Ради is one of the few Russian prepositions that may also follow its object (тебя ради in archaic style).
missions.literal: I'll do this for your sake.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: тишина (f. noun, 'silence, quiet'; nom.sg.). Per-token: В (prep., + prep. for location) | лесу (m. noun, prep.sg. of лес, special locative -у) | стояла (impf. past f.sg. of стоять, idiomatic 'reigned') | удивительная (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with тишина) | тишина (f. noun, nom.sg., subject). Лес is one of those masculine nouns with a special locative ending в лесу, на берегу, в саду.
missions.literal: In the forest there was an amazing silence.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: понятно (predicative/adv., 'understandable, clear'; from adj. понятный). Per-token: Теперь (adv., 'now') | мне (1sg pers. pron., dat., experiencer) | всё (pron., n.nom.sg., subject) | понятно (impersonal/short-predicative form, n.sg., predicate). The pattern 'кому + понятно + что' uses dative for the person to whom something is clear.
missions.literal: Now everything is clear to me.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: фронт (m. noun, 'front (military)'; нa фронте for location). Per-token: Мой (poss. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with дед) | дед (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | воевал (impf. past m.sg. of воевать, 'fought, was at war') | на (prep., + prep., conventional with 'front') | фронте (m. noun, prep.sg. of фронт). The collocation на фронте, не во фронте, follows fixed Russian usage for military fronts.
missions.literal: My grandfather fought at the front.

missions.phrase: У неё на щеке маленькая родинка.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: щека (f. noun, 'cheek'; pl. щёки, with stress shift). Per-token: У (prep., + gen. in possession) | неё (3sg.f pers. pron., gen., 'her') | на (prep., + prep. for surface location) | щеке (f. noun, prep.sg. of щека) | маленькая (adj., f.nom.sg., agrees with родинка) | родинка (f. noun, nom.sg., subject of possession). Body-part possession often combines У + gen. with a locative prepositional phrase.
missions.literal: She has a little mole on her cheek.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: страшно (predicative/adv., 'it's frightening'; from adj. страшный). Per-token: Мне (1sg pers. pron., dat., experiencer) | страшно (impersonal predicative) | оставаться (impf. infinitive of оставаться, 'to remain') | одной (adj., f.instr.sg. of одна, predicate of state). Predicatives like страшно, скучно, грустно in dat. constructions express subjective feelings.
missions.literal: I'm scared to stay alone.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: район (m. noun, 'district, area'; nom.sg.). Per-token: Мы (1pl pers. pron., nom.) | живём (1pl.pres. of жить, 'live') | в (prep., + prep. for static location) | тихом (adj., m.prep.sg., agrees with районе) | районе (m. noun, prep.sg. of район). Adjectives agree with their head noun in gender, number, and case — here all m.prep.sg.
missions.literal: We live in a quiet neighborhood.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: наверно (modal adv., 'probably'; variant of наверное). Per-token: Он (3sg.m pers. pron., nom.) | наверно (modal adv., epistemic) | уже (adv., 'already') | спит (3sg.pres. of спать, 'sleeps'). Sentence adverbs наверно, конечно, может быть express speaker stance and usually take no commas in conversational style.
missions.literal: He's probably already asleep.

missions.phrase: Я люблю проводить время с друзьями.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: проводить (impf. verb, 'to spend (time), conduct'; perf. провести). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | люблю (1sg.pres. of любить, 'love') | проводить (impf. infinitive, complement of люблю) | время (n. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | с (prep., + instr., 'with') | друзьями (m. noun, instr.pl. of друг). Любить + impf. infinitive expresses enjoying a habitual activity.
missions.literal: I love spending time with friends.

missions.phrase: У него было странное выражение лица.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: выражение (n. noun, 'expression'; nom./acc.sg. share form). Per-token: У (prep., + gen. in possession) | него (3sg.m pers. pron., gen.) | было (past n.sg. of быть, agrees with выражение) | странное (adj., n.nom.sg., agrees with выражение) | выражение (n. noun, nom.sg., subject of possession) | лица (n. noun, gen.sg. of лицо, attributive genitive). Attributive genitive (выражение лица) often replaces an English compound noun ('facial expression').
missions.literal: He had a strange expression on his face.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: слегка (adv., 'slightly, a little'). Per-token: Она (3sg.f pers. pron., nom.) | слегка (adv., manner/degree) | улыбнулась (perf. past f.sg.refl. of улыбнуться, 'smiled') | мне (1sg pers. pron., dat.; улыбнуться governs dat.). Verbs of facial gesturing — улыбнуться, подмигнуть, кивнуть — take a dative object for the recipient.
missions.literal: She smiled at me slightly.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: мешок (m. noun, 'sack, bag'; fleeting vowel -о-, gen.sg. мешка). Per-token: Он (3sg.m pers. pron., nom.) | принёс (perf. past m.sg. of принести, 'brought') | тяжёлый (adj., m.acc.sg.inan., agrees with мешок) | мешок (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | картошки (f. noun, gen.sg. of картошка, partitive). Quantity nouns (мешок, ящик, кучка) govern the genitive of the substance they contain.
missions.literal: He brought a heavy sack of potatoes.

missions.phrase: Я обещаю тебе всегда говорить правду.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: обещать (impf./perf. biaspectual verb, 'to promise'; governs dat. of person). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | обещаю (1sg.pres. of обещать) | тебе (2sg pers. pron., dat., recipient) | всегда (adv., frequency) | говорить (impf. infinitive of говорить, 'to tell') | правду (f. noun, acc.sg. of правда, direct object of говорить). Обещать is bi-aspectual: it can function as both imperfective and perfective depending on context.
missions.literal: I promise you I'll always tell the truth.

missions.phrase: Это слишком дорогой подарок для меня.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: дорогой (adj., 'expensive, dear'; stressed endings). Per-token: Это (demonstr. particle, 'this is') | слишком (adv., 'too', degree) | дорогой (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with подарок) | подарок (m. noun, nom.sg., predicate nominative) | для (prep., + gen., 'for') | меня (1sg pers. pron., gen.). 'Слишком' precedes the adjective it intensifies, just like English 'too'.
missions.literal: This is too expensive a gift for me.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: судить (impf. verb, 'to judge'; governs acc. of person; 'по + dat.' for criterion). Per-token: Не (negation particle) | суди (2sg.imperative of судить) | людей (m. noun, acc./gen.pl. of человек, suppletive plural, animate) | по (prep., + dat., 'by/according to') | внешности (f. noun, dat.sg. of внешность). The prepositional phrase 'по + dative' commonly marks the criterion or basis of judgment.
missions.literal: Don't judge people by appearance.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: большинство (n. collective noun, 'majority'; takes pl. agreement when modifying animate humans). Per-token: Большинство (n. noun, nom.sg., subject) | студентов (m. noun, gen.pl. of студент, partitive after большинство) | сдали (perf. past pl. of сдать, 'passed') | экзамен (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object). With collective subjects + animate gen.pl., the verb usually agrees in the plural for natural human reference.
missions.literal: The majority of students passed the exam.

missions.phrase: Мы решили собраться у меня дома.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: собраться (perf. refl. verb, 'to gather; to get oneself ready'; impf. собираться). Per-token: Мы (1pl pers. pron., nom.) | решили (perf. past pl. of решить, 'decided') | собраться (perf. infinitive, complement of решили) | у (prep., + gen., 'at someone's place') | меня (1sg pers. pron., gen.) | дома (adv., 'at home', from 'home' in gen. frozen as adverb). The phrase у меня дома means 'at my place', using the dative-like frozen дома.
missions.literal: We decided to get together at my place.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: управление (n. noun, 'management, control'; governs instr.). Per-token: Управление (n. noun, nom.sg., subject) | компанией (f. noun, instr.sg. of компания, governed by управление) | требует (3sg.pres. of требовать, 'requires', + gen.) | опыта (m. noun, gen.sg. of опыт, governed by требует). The verb управлять (and its nominalization управление) govern the instrumental — never the accusative.
missions.literal: Managing a company requires experience.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: колоть (impf. verb, 'to chop/split; to prick'; perf. расколоть, заколоть). Per-token: Дедушка (m. noun by meaning, nom.sg., subject; declines f.-style) | любит (3sg.pres. of любить, 'loves') | колоть (impf. infinitive, complement) | дрова (n.pl. noun, acc.pl., direct object; only used in plural) | осенью (f. noun, instr.sg. of осень, 'in autumn'). The plural-only noun дрова ('firewood') never appears in the singular.
missions.literal: Grandpa loves chopping firewood in autumn.

missions.phrase: После дождя мой плащ совсем мокрый.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: мокрый (adj., 'wet'; short form мокр, мокра). Per-token: После (prep., + gen., 'after') | дождя (m. noun, gen.sg. of дождь) | мой (poss. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with плащ) | плащ (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | совсем (adv., 'completely', intensifier) | мокрый (adj., m.nom.sg., predicate adjective). Predicate adjectives in present-tense быть-less clauses stay in the nominative, agreeing with the subject.
missions.literal: After the rain my raincoat is completely wet.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: приказ (m. noun, 'order, command'; nom./acc.sg. share form). Per-token: Командир (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | отдал (perf. past m.sg. of отдать, 'gave/issued') | чёткий (adj., m.acc.sg.inan., agrees with приказ) | приказ (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object). The collocation отдать приказ ('to issue an order') uses отдать rather than дать.
missions.literal: The commander issued a clear order.

missions.phrase: Это самый прямой путь к озеру.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: прямой (adj., 'straight, direct'; stressed endings). Per-token: Это (demonstr. particle, 'this is') | самый (superlative-forming pron./adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with путь) | прямой (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with путь) | путь (m. noun, nom.sg., predicate nominative; irregular declension) | к (prep., + dat., 'to/toward') | озеру (n. noun, dat.sg. of озеро). The pattern самый + adjective is the standard analytic superlative in Russian.
missions.literal: This is the most direct way to the lake.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: закричать (perf. verb, 'to start shouting'; ingressive prefix за-; impf. кричать). Per-token: От (prep., + gen., 'from/out of (cause)') | боли (f. noun, gen.sg. of боль) | он (3sg.m pers. pron., nom.) | громко (adv., manner) | закричал (perf. past m.sg. of закричать). The prefix за- on verbs of sound/motion often marks the beginning of an action — закричать = to begin to shout.
missions.literal: He cried out loudly from pain.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: кончиться (perf. refl. verb, intransitive 'to end, come to an end'; impf. кончаться). Per-token: Концерт (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | должен (short adj., m.sg., 'must/should') | скоро (adv., 'soon') | кончиться (perf. infinitive, complement of должен). Reflexive -ся here makes the verb intransitive: events end on their own.
missions.literal: The concert should end soon.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: куст (m. noun, 'bush'; nom.sg.). Per-token: За (prep., + instr. for static location 'behind') | домом (m. noun, instr.sg. of дом) | растёт (3sg.pres. of расти, 'grows') | большой (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with куст) | куст (m. noun, nom.sg., subject). The preposition за takes the instrumental for location 'behind' and accusative for motion 'to behind'.
missions.literal: Behind the house grows a big bush.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: стрелять (impf. verb, 'to shoot'; perf. выстрелить; takes 'из + gen.' for weapon, 'в + acc.' for target). Per-token: Здесь (adv., 'here') | запрещено (short passive part., n.sg., 'is prohibited', + infinitive) | стрелять (impf. infinitive, complement) | из (prep., + gen., 'from/with (a weapon)') | ружья (n. noun, gen.sg. of ружьё). The pattern стрелять из + gen. specifies the weapon used, distinct from стрелять в + acc. for the target.
missions.literal: Shooting from a rifle is prohibited here.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: художник (m. noun, 'artist, painter'; animate, nom.sg.). Per-token: Молодой (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with художник) | художник (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | нарисовал (perf. past m.sg. of нарисовать, 'drew/painted') | портрет (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object). The perfective нарисовать highlights the completion and result of the act of drawing.
missions.literal: A young artist painted a portrait.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: знак (m. noun, 'sign'; nom.sg.). Per-token: Дорожный (adj., m.nom.sg., agrees with знак) | знак (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | предупреждает (3sg.pres. of предупреждать, impf., 'warns') | об (prep., variant of о before vowel, + prep., 'about') | опасности (f. noun, prep.sg. of опасность). The preposition о changes to об before words starting with a vowel for ease of pronunciation.
missions.literal: The road sign warns of danger.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: завод (m. noun, 'factory, plant'; nom.sg.). Per-token: Этот (demonstr. pron., m.nom.sg., agrees with завод) | завод (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | производит (3sg.pres. of производить, impf., 'produces') | автомобили (m. noun, acc.pl. of автомобиль, direct object). Inanimate plural accusative equals the nominative plural form.
missions.literal: This factory produces cars.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: кулак (m. noun, 'fist'; nom./acc.sg. share form for inanimate). Per-token: Он (3sg.m pers. pron., nom.) | со (prep., variant of с before consonant clusters, + instr.) | злостью (f. noun, instr.sg. of злость, 'with anger') | сжал (perf. past m.sg. of сжать, 'clenched') | кулак (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object). The preposition с changes to со before certain consonant clusters (со мной, со злостью).
missions.literal: He clenched his fist with anger.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: использовать (biaspectual verb, 'to use'; functions as both impf. and perf.). Per-token: Можно (impersonal predicative, 'is it allowed', + infinitive) | использовать (infinitive, complement) | словарь (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | на (prep., + prep. for event location) | экзамене (m. noun, prep.sg. of экзамен). The impersonal можно asks permission and pairs naturally with an infinitive complement.
missions.literal: Can I use a dictionary on the exam?

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: стакан (m. noun, 'glass'; nom./acc.sg. share form). Per-token: Налей (2sg.imperative of налить, perf., 'pour') | мне (1sg pers. pron., dat., recipient) | стакан (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | холодной (adj., f.gen.sg., agrees with воды) | воды (f. noun, gen.sg. of вода, partitive after стакан). Quantity nouns like стакан, чашка, бутылка govern the genitive of the contents.
missions.literal: Pour me a glass of cold water.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: пахнуть (impf. verb, 'to smell of'; impersonal use 'it smells'; governs instr. of substance). Per-token: В (prep., + prep. for location) | кухне (f. noun, prep.sg. of кухня) | очень (adv., intensifier) | вкусно (adv., manner, 'tasty/deliciously') | пахнет (3sg.pres. of пахнуть, impersonal). When the source of the smell isn't named, пахнуть is used impersonally in the 3sg.
missions.literal: It smells very delicious in the kitchen.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: отсюда (adv. of source, 'from here'; deictic). Per-token: Отсюда (adv., source) | до (prep., + gen., 'up to/until') | моря (n. noun, gen.sg. of море) | всего (adv., 'only, just', particle of restriction) | километр (m. noun, nom.sg., subject of an elided 'is'). The trio оттуда/отсюда/откуда (from there/here/where) parallels туда/сюда/куда and там/здесь/где.
missions.literal: From here it's only a kilometer to the sea.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: рот (m. noun, 'mouth'; gen.sg. рта with fleeting vowel). Per-token: Открой (2sg.imperative of открыть, perf., 'open') | рот (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | пошире (comparative adv. of широко, 'wider', with mitigating по-) | пожалуйста (politeness particle). The prefix по- on comparatives softens them — пошире = 'a bit wider', not just 'wider'.
missions.literal: Open your mouth a bit wider, please.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: пора (predicative, 'it's time to'; identical in form to noun пора 'time/period'; + infinitive). Per-token: Уже (adv., 'already') | поздно (impersonal predicative, 'it's late') | пора (predicative, 'it's time', + infinitive) | идти (impf. unidirectional infinitive of идти, 'to go') | домой (adv. of direction, 'homeward'). Both поздно and пора are impersonal predicatives; they head subjectless clauses.
missions.literal: It's already late; time to go home.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: передать (perf. verb, 'to pass on, convey'; impf. передавать). Per-token: Передай (2sg.imperative of передать) | ей (3sg.f pers. pron., dat., recipient) | привет (m. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | от (prep., + gen., 'from') | меня (1sg pers. pron., gen.). Передать takes a dative for the receiver and an accusative for the thing conveyed: передать (что) (кому).
missions.literal: Give her my regards.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: лечение (n. noun, 'treatment'; nom./acc.sg. share form). Per-token: Лечение (n. noun, nom.sg., subject) | оказалось (perf. past n.sg.refl. of оказаться, 'turned out (to be)', + instr.) | долгим (adj., n.instr.sg., agrees with лечение) | и (coord. conj., 'and') | трудным (adj., n.instr.sg., agrees with лечение). The verb оказаться takes its predicate complement in the instrumental case.
missions.literal: The treatment turned out to be long and difficult.

missions.phrase: Она получила высшее образование в Москве.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: высший (adj., 'higher/highest'; suppletive comparative/superlative of высокий in fixed collocations). Per-token: Она (3sg.f pers. pron., nom.) | получила (perf. past f.sg. of получить, 'received') | высшее (adj., n.acc.sg., agrees with образование) | образование (n. noun, acc.sg., direct object) | в (prep., + prep. for static location) | Москве (f. noun, prep.sg. of Москва). 'Высшее образование' is a fixed collocation meaning 'university-level education'.
missions.literal: She received a higher education in Moscow.

missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: сутки (pl.-only noun, 'a 24-hour period, day-and-night'; no singular form). Per-token: Поезд (m. noun, nom.sg., subject) | опоздал (perf. past m.sg. of опоздать, 'was late') | почти (adv., 'almost') | на (prep., + acc. for amount of delay) | сутки (pl.-only noun, acc.pl., extent of delay). The preposition на + acc. with verbs of delay or shifting marks the size of the gap (опоздать на час, на сутки).
missions.literal: The train was almost a full day late.

missions.phrase: Я не люблю рано вставать зимой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Focus word: вставать (impf. verb, 'to get up, rise'; perf. встать). Per-token: Я (1sg pers. pron., nom.) | не (negation particle) | люблю (1sg.pres. of любить, 'love') | рано (adv., time) | вставать (impf. infinitive, complement of люблю) | зимой (f. noun, instr.sg. of зима, 'in winter'). Любить + impf. infinitive expresses a habitual preference; negating it expresses a habitual dislike.
missions.literal: I don't like getting up early in winter.
